raw.title: Build Your Own Internship – m/f/d (min. 6 Months)
raw.description:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

 

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe’s largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows, helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

 

About the Role

This is a full-time internship of at least 6 months at our Berlin HQ, and it is not a regular internship application. We don’t want your CV first. We want to see what you have built.

If you build with AI because you can’t stop, with Langdock, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or anything else, show us. If your project convinces us, we shape the internship around you and your strengths.

 

What We Want to See

Record a Loom of something you built with AI. It should be no longer than 5 minutes. Two kinds of projects get our attention:

  • Something that would help Langdock. Look at our product roadmap and at our product, and build something that solves a real problem for us or our customers. That could be a feature prototype, an internal tool, a GTM engine, a support automation, an eval setup, or something we haven’t thought of yet.

  • A genuine passion project. Something you built because you couldn’t stop thinking about it, and that shows how you think.

What we don’t want: basic chatbots, simple prompt wrappers, “summarize my inbox” agents, or linear three-step workflows. Our customers build those every day. Show us something that made you think hard, and that makes us think too.

 

What Your Loom Should Cover

  • The problem: what you solved and why it matters.

  • The demo: show it working live, not on slides.

  • How it’s built: the models, tools, architecture, and key decisions behind it.

  • What broke: where it failed and what you learned from that.

  • What’s next: what you would build at Langdock if you joined.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own a real project. Ideally it’s the one you showed us. You take it from prototype to something our team or customers actually use.

  • Work directly with the team. You work alongside Product, Engineering, or GTM, depending on where your project lives.

  • Ship, measure, iterate. You present your progress regularly and decide based on real feedback.

 

How to Apply

Paste your Loom URL into the field “Your Build” in the application form. Your LinkedIn profile is enough; a CV is optional.

 

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • You build, not just talk about AI. You have shipped things that work, even if they’re rough.

  • You think in impact, not just in technology.

  • You show high agency. You don’t wait for tasks; you find them.

  • You experiment constantly with new models and tools.

  • You communicate clearly and professionally in English. German is a plus.

  • You are kind and care about the people around you.

 

What We Need

  • Availability for a full-time internship of at least 6 months, 100% on-site in Berlin.

  • A work permit for Germany.

 

The Environment

You will work from our Berlin office at Greifswalder Straße 212, where all of us work together in person, surrounded by people building AI products and infrastructure every day. Lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, and gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. We value Calm Urgency, Ambitious Execution, and Caring Ownership. The vibe is calm but intense.

 

Next Steps

We move fast. If you have built something you’re proud of, show us.

The Role Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area. Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues. Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators. People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business. People who say no without offering a compliant way forward. People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions. Location This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week. You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. title: Senior Projektmanager Marketing (m/w/d) - Agentur für Handelsmarketing
description: TEAMWFP ist eine Agentur für kreatives VkF-Marketing in Mönchengladbach. Seit 45 Jahren betreut die Agentur Unternehmen aus Handel und Finanzen in der Verkaufs- und Markenkommunikation: Prospekte, Mailings, Instore Design, Verpackungen und Kampagnen, für Kunden wie PENNY, Kaufland oder die Sparkassen. Gesucht wird eine erfahrene Beraterin oder ein erfahrener Berater als Senior Projektmanager Marketing (m/w/d) in Vollzeit: die Schnittstelle zwischen Kreation und Kunde, mit eigenen Kunden und einem Beraterteam von fünf bis sechs Leuten. Das Besondere bei TEAMWFP: Jeder Kunde wird auf Senior-Level betreut. Es gibt keinen Kunden, der an Praktikanten und Junioren abgegeben wird, und keine Ebene, die zwischen dir und deiner Arbeit steht. Im Agenturverbund arbeiten rund 30 Leute. Große Meetings gibt es kaum, vieles wird kurz über den Flur abgestimmt, und die beiden Creative Directors arbeiten selbst mit am Produkt. Du berätst viele Kunden aus Handel und Finanzen, ohne mehrere Ebenen zwischen dir und den Entscheidungen und ohne jeden Tag nach Düsseldorf zu pendeln. Deine Aufgaben Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Kreation und Kunde und koordinierst jedes Projekt vom Briefing bis zur Produktionsreife. Du vertrittst die Agentur in Abstimmungen beim Kunden und arbeitest dich inhaltlich in alle Projekte ein. Du bereitest Briefings verständlich für dein Team auf und erarbeitest kommunikative Lösungen, allein oder mit der Kreation. Du prüfst alle Werbemittel formal und inhaltlich, bevor sie an den Kunden gehen, und kalkulierst und überwachst die Kosten selbst. Du übernimmst Beratungsaufgaben der Geschäftsführung und steuerst das Beraterteam mit. Was du mitbringst Eine Ausbildung als Kaufmann oder Kauffrau für Marketingkommunikation oder ein Studium im Bereich Marketing. Erfahrung zählt mehr als der Abschluss. Erfahrung im Agenturumfeld oder in einer Marketingabteilung auf Kundenseite, Handelsmarketing ist ein Plus. Fundiertes Marketingwissen, mit dem du Kunden strategisch berätst und Leistungen verkaufst. Du greifst gern zum Hörer, behältst in vollen Phasen die Ruhe und bist sicher in Excel, Word und PowerPoint. Sehr gutes Deutsch ist Voraussetzung. Was dich bei TEAMWFP erwartet Ein Gehalt ab 4.000 € im Monat, je nach Erfahrung nach oben offen. Senior-Level auf jedem Kunden: In Beratung und Kreation sitzen erfahrene Leute am Tisch, Entscheidungen fallen schnell und direkt. Viele Kunden und nie dasselbe: Vom Handel bis zur Bank übernimmt die Agentur fast jede Aufgabe, die ein Kunde stellt, und arbeitet bei den meisten Kunden nicht in festen Teams. Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit von 10 bis 15 Uhr, Überstunden werden ausgeglichen. Wochenend- und Nachtschichten gibt es nicht. Ein fester, eigener Arbeitsplatz in kleinen Büros für eine bis drei Personen statt Großraum und Desk Sharing. Ein Backsteinbau im Nordpark mit Aufenthaltsraum und Billardtisch, aus Gladbach auch gut mit dem Fahrrad erreichbar. Ehrlich gesagt: Als Schnittstelle hängst du an vielen Leuten. Vom Kunden brauchst du Infos, von Konzept und Gestaltung pünktliche Ergebnisse, und phasenweise wird es stressig. Der Tipp aus dem Team: von Anfang an die eigenen Grenzen setzen. Diese Stelle wird über JobMatches vorgestellt. Bewirb dich jetzt als Senior Projektmanager Marketing (m/w/d) bei TEAMWFP in Mönchengladbach. Nach einem kurzen Telefonat lernst du Kim Finocchiaro und die Geschäftsführung persönlich kennen. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Enablement Manager (Client Operations)
description: StackFuel/Multiverse Germany verbindet Arbeit und Lernen, um einen chancengerechten Zugang zu wirtschaftlichen Perspektiven zu schaffen. Wir schließen kritische Kompetenzlücken in den Bereichen Daten und KI, mit praxisnahen, begleiteten und messbaren Upskilling- und Reskilling-Programmen. Client Operations ist der Ort, an dem unsere Programme auf die Praxis treffen: Fördergeber, Arbeitgeber, Partner und Lernende sind darauf angewiesen, dass dieses Team einen hervorragenden Job macht – von der Anmeldung und Förderverwaltung bis hin zur täglichen Kundenkommunikation und Problemlösung. Die Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Konsistenz dieser Arbeit wirkt sich unmittelbar auf die Lernendenbindung, die Kundenzufriedenheit und unsere regulatorische Stellung aus. Diese Rolle gibt es, um dieses Team exzellent zu machen. Du stellst sicher, dass jedes Mitglied von Client Operations bereit, auf dem neuesten Stand und selbstsicher ist; von der ersten Woche an und bei jeder Prozess-, Tool- und Regulierungsänderung, die danach folgt. Du setzt KI-Tools täglich in deiner eigenen Arbeit ein und unterstützt das Team dabei, sie zu nutzen, um klüger statt nur härter zu arbeiten. Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit Menschen auf allen Ebenen zusammen – Client Operations, Delivery, Learning, Quality und der Geschäftsleitung – und lernst, wie ein Bildungsanbieter von Anfang bis Ende funktioniert. Und du hast ein Mitspracherecht dabei, wie wir uns weiter verbessern. Deine Aufgaben: Du verantwortest das Onboarding und Reboarding für Client Operations: Du setzt den Standard, entwickelst die Inhalte und führst die Sessions durch. Du integrierst regulatorische und prozessuale Änderungen (AZAV, Agentur für Arbeit, Förderrichtlinien) in die Enablement-Arbeit, sodass das Team bereits vor dem Inkrafttreten von Änderungen auf dem aktuellen Stand ist. Du definierst den Standard für Kundenkommunikation, Fallbearbeitung und Dokumentation – schriftlich festgehalten, geschult und messbar. Du erstellst Playbooks und Schulungsinhalte, die Teamleitungen gemeinsam mit ihren Teams verankern. Du machst aus Qualitätsdaten gezieltes Enablement: Du erkennst Muster bei Fehlern, Eskalationen und Audit-Feststellungen und übersetzt sie in Schulungen, die diese nachweislich reduzieren. Du treibst die Einführung von Tools und KI voran: Du findest heraus, wo KI manuelle Arbeit abnehmen kann, pilotierst sie und schulst das Team. Du baust Multiplikatoren auf: Du gibst Aufgaben an Champions und Buddys im Team weiter und unterstützt sie dabei, diese erfolgreich zu übernehmen. Das bringst du mit: Umfangreiche Erfahrung in den Bereichen Operations, Kundenservice oder Programmadministration, idealerweise im öffentlich geförderten Bildungsbereich oder in einem anderen regulierten Umfeld. Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Durchführung von Onboardings oder Trainings für operative Teams – und darin, zu überprüfen, ob sie wirksam waren. Ausgeprägtes Prozessdenken und Sicherheit im Umgang mit Qualitätsdaten: Du erkennst Muster und leitest daraus einen Plan ab. Souveränität darin, ehrliches Feedback zu geben und Ergebnisse durch Menschen zu erzielen, denen gegenüber du keine Führungsverantwortung hast. Praktische Neugier auf KI-Tools. Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse. Kenntnisse der AZAV, des SGB III sowie der Prozesse der Agentur für Arbeit / Jobcenter – dringend erwünscht. Das bieten wir Dir Arbeitskultur Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle. Ownership Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit. Hybrides Arbeiten Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin. Workation Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten. Raum für Austausch Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander. Weiterentwicklung Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Client Operations ist der Ort, an dem unsere Programme auf die Praxis treffen: Fördergeber, Arbeitgeber, Partner und Lernende sind darauf angewiesen, dass dieses Team einen hervorragenden Job macht – von der Anmeldung und Förderverwaltung bis hin zur täglichen Kundenkommunikation und Problemlösung. Die Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Konsistenz dieser Arbeit wirkt sich unmittelbar auf die Lernendenbindung, die Kundenzufriedenheit und unsere regulatorische Stellung aus.

Diese Rolle gibt es, um dieses Team exzellent zu machen. Du stellst sicher, dass jedes Mitglied von Client Operations bereit, auf dem neuesten Stand und selbstsicher ist; von der ersten Woche an und bei jeder Prozess-, Tool- und Regulierungsänderung, die danach folgt. Du setzt KI-Tools täglich in deiner eigenen Arbeit ein und unterstützt das Team dabei, sie zu nutzen, um klüger statt nur härter zu arbeiten.

Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit Menschen auf allen Ebenen zusammen – Client Operations, Delivery, Learning, Quality und der Geschäftsleitung – und lernst, wie ein Bildungsanbieter von Anfang bis Ende funktioniert. Und du hast ein Mitspracherecht dabei, wie wir uns weiter verbessern.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du verantwortest das Onboarding und Reboarding für Client Operations: Du setzt den Standard, entwickelst die Inhalte und führst die Sessions durch.

  • Du integrierst regulatorische und prozessuale Änderungen (AZAV, Agentur für Arbeit, Förderrichtlinien) in die Enablement-Arbeit, sodass das Team bereits vor dem Inkrafttreten von Änderungen auf dem aktuellen Stand ist.

  • Du definierst den Standard für Kundenkommunikation, Fallbearbeitung und Dokumentation – schriftlich festgehalten, geschult und messbar.

  • Du erstellst Playbooks und Schulungsinhalte, die Teamleitungen gemeinsam mit ihren Teams verankern.

  • Du machst aus Qualitätsdaten gezieltes Enablement: Du erkennst Muster bei Fehlern, Eskalationen und Audit-Feststellungen und übersetzt sie in Schulungen, die diese nachweislich reduzieren.

  • Du treibst die Einführung von Tools und KI voran: Du findest heraus, wo KI manuelle Arbeit abnehmen kann, pilotierst sie und schulst das Team.

  • Du baust Multiplikatoren auf: Du gibst Aufgaben an Champions und Buddys im Team weiter und unterstützt sie dabei, diese erfolgreich zu übernehmen.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Umfangreiche Erfahrung in den Bereichen Operations, Kundenservice oder Programmadministration, idealerweise im öffentlich geförderten Bildungsbereich oder in einem anderen regulierten Umfeld.

  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Durchführung von Onboardings oder Trainings für operative Teams – und darin, zu überprüfen, ob sie wirksam waren.

  • Ausgeprägtes Prozessdenken und Sicherheit im Umgang mit Qualitätsdaten: Du erkennst Muster und leitest daraus einen Plan ab.

  • Souveränität darin, ehrliches Feedback zu geben und Ergebnisse durch Menschen zu erzielen, denen gegenüber du keine Führungsverantwortung hast.

  • Praktische Neugier auf KI-Tools.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Kenntnisse der AZAV, des SGB III sowie der Prozesse der Agentur für Arbeit / Jobcenter – dringend erwünscht.

Das bieten wir Dir

Arbeitskultur
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership
Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Hybrides Arbeiten
Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Workation
Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch
Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung
Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

Als führende Beteiligungsgesellschaft (VC/Accelerator) im Bereich eCommerce für D2C & Lifestyle-Brands bieten wir unseren über 20 Portfoliounternehmen nicht nur finanzielle Unterstützung, sondern fungieren darüber hinaus als aktiver Partner bei sämtlichen Herausforderungen des Unternehmertums – von der Finanzplanung bis zum Marketing.

Aktuell sind wir auf der Suche nach qualifizierter Verstärkung für unser Performance Marketing Team.

Als Teil unseres Performance Teams unterstützt du unsere Portfoliounternehmen bei der Konzeption und Ausspielung sämtlicher Werbeanzeigen und bist unmittelbar für das Wachstum mitverantwortlich.

Du bringst bereits erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Performance Marketing mit? Du verfügst über eine analytische Denkweise, bist aber trotzdem kreativ? Dann bist du die perfekte Ergänzung für unser Team!

Aufgaben

  • Du konzipierst und betreust die Performance-Kampagnen unserer Portfolio-& Partnerunternehmen auf Google (Search, Shopping, PMax, YouTube) und Meta.

  • Du optimierst Kampagnen laufend: Gebote, Zielgruppen, Strukturen, Budgets und Creatives.

  • Du steuerst Budgets und Pacing und behältst die Ziel-KPIs deiner Projekte im Blick.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Design-Team die Creative Strategy, schreibst Briefings und Ad Copies und bewertest die Performance einzelner Assets.

  • Du stellst sauberes Tracking sicher (Meta Pixel & Conversions API, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Merchant Center) in Abstimmung mit unserem Development-Team.

  • Du analysierst Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen, erstellst monatliche Reports und leitest daraus konkrete Next Steps ab.

  • Du bist direkte:r AnsprechpartnerIn unserer Partnerunternehmen, präsentierst Ergebnisse und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Accounts.

  • Du beobachtest Wettbewerb, Plattform-Updates und neue Ad-Formate und bringst sie proaktiv ins Team.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast erste Erfahrung mit Paid Social und SEA, Schwerpunkt Meta Ads und Google Ads.

  • Du hast erste Erfahrung mit Shopify, WordPress, Google Analytics 4 und dem Google Tag Manager.

  • Du verstehst E-Commerce-KPIs wie ROAS, CAC, Conversion Rate, AOV und Customer Lifetime Value.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Google Sheets bzw. Excel; Erfahrung mit Looker Studio oder Reporting-Tools ist ein Plus.

  • Dein analytisches Gespür lässt dich die richtigen Maßnahmen für deine KundInnen ableiten.

  • Du hast ein Gefühl dafür, was ein gutes Creative ausmacht, und denkst in Hooks, Formaten und Zielgruppen.

  • Du nutzt AI-Tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini etc.) regelmäßig und hast Lust, Workflows damit smarter zu machen.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und mit Hands-on-Mentalität.

Benefits

  • Modernes Office mit Dachterrasse im Herzen Frankfurts

  • Zuschuss für eine Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft

  • Snacks und Getränke aufs Haus

  • Attraktive Rabatte bei unseren Partner-Brands

  • Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten nach deinen Wünschen

  • Echte Übernahmechance bei guter Performance

  • Fehlt etwas? Lass uns wissen, was dir wichtig ist!

Interesse? Dann freuen wir uns auf ein kurzes Anschreiben inkl. präferierter Starttermin, deinen CV und ein Link zu deinem Portfolio.

title: Email Marketing Specialist (m/f/d)

In this role, you’ll focus on email marketing and marketing automation – building campaigns, creating targeted audiences, developing automated workflows, and using performance insights to continuously improve our communications. You’ll work closely with regional Marketing, Content, Design and Sales teams in an international environment and help us deliver relevant communications throughout the customer lifecycle. Your Job Plan, build, test and optimize email campaigns, newsletters and automated marketing workflows in HubSpot . Create relevant audience segments based on customer data, behavior and lifecycle stages. Build and improve automated journeys such as nurture, follow-up, re-engagement and lifecycle campaigns. Use personalization and dynamic content to make communications more relevant to different audiences. Monitor campaign performance and turn key metrics and A/B test results into practical improvements. Ensure campaigns are thoroughly tested before launch, including links, tracking, personalization, segmentation and responsive display. Collaborate with Content, Design, Regional Marketing and Sales teams to deliver effective campaigns. Help maintain clean and reliable marketing data and support the connection between HubSpot, Salesforce and our website. Experience creating email campaigns, automated workflows, audience segments and customer journeys. A good understanding of campaign performance and the ability to use data to improve future campaigns. Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to campaign testing and quality assurance. Comfortable working with CRM data and collaborating with Marketing and Sales stakeholders. Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for email adjustments is helpful, but you don’t need to be a developer. Strong communication skills and confidence working in an international, collaborative environment. Nice to Have Experience working with Salesforce alongside a marketing automation platform. Experience in an international or B2B marketing environment. Familiarity with more advanced HubSpot functionality, integrations or reporting. Your Benefits Be part of a growing global company in one of the most dynamic industries — cybersecurity. Short decision paths and flat hierarchies in an open working atmosphere. Personal and professional development opportunities. Home-office option and flexible, trust-based working time. Be-Active Bonus — allowance for membership in fitness and sports clubs. Wir sind

Als innovatives und wachsendes Unternehmen erfinden wir uns täglich neu. Dabei setzen wir konsequent auf Zukunftstechnologien: In unserem Lager übernimmt Robotik die Kommissionierung, und künstliche Intelligenz unterstützt uns in immer mehr Bereichen, von der Datenanalyse über Produkttexte bis zur Automatisierung unserer Abläufe. Zu unseren großen Stärken gehören schnellste Versandzeiten und unschlagbare Preise durch schlanke Prozesse, die einer ständigen Verbesserung unterliegen.

Deine Aufgaben, Dein neuer Job

Du kennst dich bestens mit Amazon aus und betreust bei uns alle Amazon-Themen. Mit deinem Fachwissen, deinem analytischen Blick und deinem Gespür für Zahlen sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Marken auf Amazon wachsen, profitabel bleiben und sicher aufgestellt sind:

  • Überwache laufend die Performance unserer Produkte (Umsatz, Sessions, Conversion, Buy-Box-Anteil, Rankings) und leite bei Abweichungen schnell die richtigen Maßnahmen ab

  • Plane, steuere und optimiere Werbekampagnen (Sponsored Products, Brands und Display) im Sinne eines datengetriebenen Performance Marketings mit Blick auf ACoS, TACoS und Profitabilität

  • Entwickle Preis- und Deal-Strategien und setze Coupons, Deals, Prime Day und Black Friday gezielt ein

  • Optimiere bestehende Listings dort, wo die Daten Potenzial zeigen, und stimme neue Listings und A+ Content mit unserem Content-Team ab

raw.title: Director Solutions (m/f/d)
raw.description:
Director Solutions (m/f/d) · Stuttgart, with frequent travel to customer sites in Europe and the US · Reports to the CEO · Full-time

Who we are

Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex, our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems and mobile manipulators that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL.

Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles.

Why this role, why now

A robot deal is won twice: once when the contract is signed, and once when the cell runs the customer’s orders at the throughput we promised. The distance between the two is decided before anyone unpacks a crate: by the site survey, the item spectrum, the cell concept, the integration with the customer’s warehouse systems, and by the number we write into the contract.

We are moving from single stations to fleets, with customers who order dozens of systems at once. The deals are getting larger, the sites more varied, and a concept that does not fit the site is paid for in months of commissioning. We are looking for the technical counterpart to our sales team: a leader who sits next to every account executive from the first conversation and makes deals technically feasible. Someone who has deployed robots personally, knows what a real site does to a design, finds the solution that makes the customer’s use case work, and makes sure what we promise is what we can build.

The Real-World Learning Loop starts with your design

Cortex learns from live deployments. The cell you design is the body the model works in, and a concept that goes live in weeks instead of months is weeks of real-world data no one else has.

  • In-Situ Policy Execution. Every station runs the current policy on the customer’s items. Your surface on it: reach, camera placement and item presentation that let the policy do its job on day one.

  • Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own work while they run. Your surface on it: standard cells with a known stack wherever possible, so every pick teaches the same model.

  • Data Curation and Learning. Edge cases decide what Cortex learns next. Your surface on it: the item spectrum and the sample tests you run before signature, so curation starts before go-live.

  • Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies return to the fleet after validation. Your surface on it: concepts that transfer, so a policy proven on one cell works on the next.

A site designed right goes live faster, teaches Cortex more, and grows.

Responsibilities

  • Be Sales’ technical counterpart on every deal. One solutions lead next to every account executive, from the first customer conversation to signature. Your job is to make the deal technically feasible: understand the customer’s process, find the solution that works for their site and items, and give Sales a technical story the customer’s engineers believe.

  • Own the technical solution for every deal, from the first site visit to the signed scope: site survey, process and material-flow analysis, item spectrum, cell concept and layout, reach and camera study, integration concept for WMS, WCS and conveyors, safety concept. One package per deal, and you are accountable for it.

  • Set the number. Throughput, pick success and intervention rates we commit to per site, derived from the item spectrum and the site and checked against what comparable live sites actually do. No KPI goes into a contract without your sign-off.

  • Standard first. Configure our standard single-arm, dual-arm and mobile products to the site. Every deviation is a documented decision taken with Engineering, not a discovery during installation.

  • Run the gate. No contract is signed without your solution design sign-off and a delivery slot agreed with Operations. You hold the pen on the technical statement of work, the acceptance criteria and the site-readiness list the customer has to meet.

  • Make it feasible, fast. Sample tests, pick studies and scanning or dimensioning checks with our applied AI team, within days, not months. When a requirement does not fit, find the version that does: a different cell or item presentation, a phased scope, a pilot that proves the hard part first. A no is the last answer, not the first.

  • Hand over to Deployment a package that builds: layout, configuration, integration spec, acceptance criteria, risks and dates, so commissioning executes without reopening the concept. You stay accountable until the first live orders prove the design.

  • Own the interfaces to integrators and WMS vendors at the solution level, from AutoStore and goods-to-person systems to conveyor and WMS partners: interface specs, a clear split of responsibilities and readiness tests before we ship.

  • Build the solution library: reference designs per use case (goods-to-person ports, put walls, returns, decanting, store replenishment), throughput models, layout templates and integration patterns, so the tenth deal of a kind takes a day, not a month.

  • Close the loop from the field. What commissioning and live sites learn about a design flows back into the reference concepts and into requirements for Product and Engineering.

  • Lead the big pursuits in person: the technical counterpart to the customer’s engineering and operations teams in fleet deals, tenders and RFPs; demos and reference visits with the customer’s real items.

  • Build and lead the Solutions team in Europe and the US: solutions engineers who have stood at a cell, with the playbooks and tools (CAD, simulation, throughput models) to do this at ten times today’s deal flow.

  • Partner with Sales, Operations and Deployment, Service Accounts, Systems Engineering, Applied AI and Supply Chain. Report to the CEO and be part of the leadership team.

Not in scope, by design

  • Pricing, contract terms and closing stay with Sales. You are their technical counterpart: you own what we promise technically, how we make it work and when it can be delivered.

  • Build, installation and commissioning up to the Site Acceptance Test stay with Operations. You hand over a package that builds, and you stay accountable for the concept.

  • Live sites after acceptance stay with Service Accounts. You design for the site they will have to run.

  • Product and system design stay with Engineering and New Product Introduction. You configure the standard; what the standard lacks, you bring them as requirements.

What makes this role hard

  • Your job is to find the yes we can deliver. Most of the time that means a smarter solution, sometimes a different scope or a later date, and occasionally a no to a deal the company wants. When it is a no, you have to be right about it, with numbers.

  • The product moves fast: what the model could not do in spring it may do in autumn. You commit to today’s capability and plan for tomorrow’s, and you do not confuse the two.

  • The site is never finished. WMS, conveyors, bins and item master data belong to the customer or an integrator, and your design has to survive their reality.

  • Every shortcut in the concept comes back as months of commissioning. You carry both sides of that trade, in front of Sales and in front of Deployment.

Your first 12 months

  • First 90 days: every open deal has a solution package and a realistic commitment; the gate is in place (checklist, sign-off, delivery slot); every live site’s concept reviewed for what we would design differently today.

  • By month 6: reference designs for our three main use cases; a throughput model validated against live sites; interface specifications agreed with our three most important integration partners; the first solutions engineer in the US onboarded.

  • By month 12: deals signed in 2027 go live at the throughput in the concept, without redesign; a Solutions team in Europe and the US; a library that makes the standard deal routine.

What you bring

  • 8+ years in warehouse or factory automation, several of them in solutions, application engineering or deployment of robotic systems. You have personally deployed robots in live operations, from site survey to commissioning: piece-picking arms, dual-arm cells, mobile manipulators or AMR fleets. You know what a go-live night feels like.

  • You did it while your company grew from its first sites to dozens or hundreds, and you built the solution process rather than inheriting it.

  • You can do the work yourself: a site survey, a layout in CAD, a material-flow and throughput model, an interface specification for a WMS or WCS (APIs, PLC handshakes), a risk assessment for a cell. And you can explain it to a customer’s operations director and to our machine learning engineers in the same afternoon.

  • You have worked side by side with sales teams as their technical counterpart and helped win deals by finding a solution that works. You have led solutions or application engineers, and when a sales team pushed for a bigger number, you held the line with evidence.

  • You know the intralogistics ecosystem: AutoStore and goods-to-person systems, conveyors, the integrators; ideally e-commerce, returns or grocery fulfilment.

  • Fluent English; German is a strong plus, since many of our customers are in the DACH region. You are happy to spend a large part of your time at customer sites in Europe and the US.

Nice to have: piece-picking or dual-arm robotics · systems whose capability is driven by machine learning and moves every quarter · robotics-as-a-service models · deployments in the US.

Not the right fit: pre-sales architects who have never commissioned a system, solutions as slide-making, or anyone who needs a finished product specification before they can start.

Three questions we will ask you

  1. Walk us through a site you designed that went live at the throughput you promised, and one that did not. What was the difference?

  2. Sales wants to sign a deal this quarter with a KPI 50% above what your model says the site can do. What do you do in the next 48 hours to still make the deal work?

  3. A customer’s goods-to-person ports are fixed, and the layout leaves 30 cm less reach than our standard cell needs. What are the options, and which one do you choose?

What we offer

  • A product in live production with some of Europe’s largest operators, and the mandate to decide what we promise and what we build.

  • A seat in the leadership team of a company scaling from Europe into the US, with equity.

  • Travel, accommodation and meals covered when you are on site.

  • Our HQ in Stuttgart, with teams in Zurich and Boston.

How we hire

Conversations with the founders and our VP Operations, a working session on a real site (we give you a layout, an item spectrum and a target; you tell us what to build and what to promise), and time with the team in Stuttgart. We move fast.

  • Familiarity with US privacy and AI law (CCPA/CPRA, BIPA, and state AI and deepfake statutes)

  • A track record of advising on AI, ML or data-intensive products: you understand training pipelines, inference and feature releases well enough to ask engineers the right questions

  • Comfort giving direct, pragmatic advice under uncertainty – you can turn a novel legal question into a clear recommendation and workable product guidance

  • Strong drafting skills across DPAs, privacy notices, DPIAs and commercial privacy terms

  • Excellent written and spoken English; you can explain complex issues to researchers, executives and regulators alike

  • An ownership mindset and low ego: you’re comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where you build processes, not just follow them

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience with generative AI, computer vision or media products – particularly involving biometric data, likeness rights or synthetic media

  • German language skills

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

US $200,000 - $250,000 USD

Analysen & Reporting: Aufbereitung von Unternehmenskennzahlen, Erstellung von Präsentationen und Entscheidungsvorlagen sowie Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen. Prozessoptimierung & Umsetzung: Identifikation von Verbesserungspotenzialen, Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und aktive Umsetzung wichtiger Entscheidungen. Vorstandsbegleitung & Networking: Du begleitest unseren Vorstand zu spannenden Terminen, knüpfst Kontakte zu vielfältigen Stakeholdern und lernst unsere Unternehmensgruppe aus unterschiedlichen Perspektiven kennen. Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst gerne an, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Themen eigenständig und lösungsorientiert voran. title: Client Sales Director (m/f/d)
description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company. We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.  Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!   THE OPPORTUNITY We're hiring a Client Sales Director to lead one of our Client Enterprise Sales teams in Germany. You will manage and develop a senior team of Sales Managers, providing coaching and mentorship, shaping deal strategy, supporting high-stakes negotiations, and designing complex commercial initiatives. You'll build strategic partnerships with enterprise prospects, leading consultative sales cycles and crafting solutions tailored to their specific challenges. Beyond team leadership, you'll act as a cross-functional connector, partnering closely with Marketing, Product, Operations, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success to ensure strategic alignment, remove roadblocks, and accelerate outcomes. This is more than a job . It's a high-impact opportunity for professional and financial growth, with competitive, performance-based compensation. It's ideal for collaborative, entrepreneurial leaders who thrive in dynamic environments and value long-term customer relationships.   YOUR IMPACT Enterprise Deal Execution & Commercial Acumen: Proven track record of navigating complex, multi-stakeholder SaaS sales cycles, building data-driven ROI business cases, and consistently closing six-figure enterprise contracts. Pipeline Generation & Regional Territory Health: Demonstrates proactive outbound prospecting, tight collaboration with SDR partners, and rigorous pipeline inspection to maintain high forecasting accuracy and predictable revenue growth. Executive Presence & Stakeholder Management: Commands high-level conversations with C-suite and senior HR/Total Rewards leaders, establishing credibility, handling objections effectively, and building lasting strategic partnerships. Cross-Functional Orchestration: Effectively aligns cross-functional internal resources—including onboarding, legal, and product teams—to ensure seamless deal execution and post-sale client success. Product Mastery & Solution-Selling: Articulates Wellhub's market value proposition clearly, translating product capabilities and case studies into bespoke executive solutions tailored to enterprise pain points. Industry Representation & Network Expansion: Actively expands Wellhub's regional footprint and brand authority through targeted networking, industry event engagement, and relationship building within the HR community. Mission Alignment & Culture Contribution: Exemplifies a commitment to workplace wellbeing, modeling sustainable high performance, collaborative empathy, and strong alignment with Wellhub's core mission. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.   WHO YOU ARE Leadership & People Management: Proven experience leading and coaching senior sales managers and high-performing SaaS teams, cultivating a culture of accountability, operational rigor, and consistent quota achievement. Enterprise Revenue Growth: Track record of driving new business acquisition and closing high-value, complex deals, ideally within SaaS, HR consulting, or corporate benefits environments. Executive Presence & Stakeholder Influence: Exceptional ability to build trusted relationships with C-level buyers, navigate intricate decision-making units, and align cross-functional partners to drive strategic outcomes. Data-Driven Strategy & Pipeline Execution: Highly analytical approach to sales metrics and forecasting, leveraging CRM insights to optimize team performance, identify growth levers, and maintain predictability. Persuasive Communication & Fluency: Professional business and technical English fluency, with strong acumen in delivering executive-level presentations, financial business cases, and consultative narratives. Sales Tech & Modern Prospecting Acumen: High technical proficiency across modern sales stacks (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, SalesLoft) to scale pipeline generation and streamline sales workflows. Growth Mindset, Agility & Client Centricity: Proactive, outcome-oriented approach with a strong commitment to continuous learning, client advocacy, and navigating change in high-growth, fast-paced environments. We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience leading senior sales teams, driving new business growth, and successfully securing significant contracts with complex organizations and advanced English are mandatory requirements. WHAT WE OFFER YOU With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include: WELLHUB:   Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. Our offices are in Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Spain, and the UK. You can work from any office or remotely based in any of these countries. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!). PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.   CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.  CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.  Want to see what it's really like to work here? title: Teamleitung Naturnaher Wasserbau / Gewässerentwicklung (m/w/d)
description: Hier machst du dein Ding. Und wenn es passt, wird es auch deins. Du planst Renaturierungen, Hochwasserschutz, Gewässerentwicklung. Fachlich macht dir so schnell keiner was vor. Was oft fehlt, ist der Raum dafür: Über dein Projekt entscheidet am Ende jemand, der nie am Gewässer stand, dein Budget verantwortest du nur auf dem Papier, und mit dem Kunden spricht jemand anderes. Selbst wirksam werden. Bei Stowasserplan führst du dein eigenes Team, steuerst deinen Bereich wirtschaftlich und sprichst selbst mit deinen Auftraggebern. Du entscheidest, wie ihr arbeitet, und siehst direkt, was deine Entscheidungen bewirken. Nicht weil wir die besseren Ingenieure wären, sondern weil wir kurze Wege haben. Schrittweise einsteigen. Wir suchen keine Führungskraft auf Zeit. Wer sich bei uns gut anstellt, unternehmerisch denkt und Verantwortung übernehmen will, kann sich nach einer Einarbeitungs- und Bewährungsphase am Unternehmen beteiligen und diese Beteiligung Schritt für Schritt ausbauen. So profitierst du direkt von dem Wert, den du mit deinem Team schaffst. Bei uns führt ein Weg von der Teamleitung zur Mitgesellschafterin oder zum Mitgesellschafter. Wer wir sind Stowasserplan plant seit 2009 naturnahen Wasserbau: Renaturierung von Fließgewässern, nachhaltiger Hochwasserschutz, Starkregen- und Erosionsvorsorge, Revitalisierung von Auen. Ingenieurbiologische Bauweisen sind unsere Kernkompetenz, nicht ein Zusatz im Leistungsverzeichnis. Wie das aussieht, wenn es gelingt: Am renaturierten Pleißenbach spielen heute Kinder am Wasser. Am Hoyerswerdaer Schwarzwasser ist der Eisvogel zurück. Von der Machbarkeitsstudie über die Objektplanung nach HOAI bis zur Umweltbaubegleitung machen wir das komplett selbst. Mit unserem Schwesterunternehmen Stowasserservice entwickeln wir aus unserer Praxiserfahrung Software, mit der andere Büros und Verwaltungen arbeiten: PROGEMIS für das Gewässermanagement, SOFIE für die Ingenieurbiologie. KI nutzen wir zunehmend als Werkzeug in unseren Planungsabläufen. Die fachliche Verantwortung bleibt beim Menschen. Was du übernimmst Ein Team von fünf bis acht Leuten: Projektverantwortliche, Projektmitarbeitende, Praktikanten. Du führst sie, planst Kapazitäten, führst die Mitarbeitergespräche und arbeitest neue Leute ein. Die wirtschaftliche Steuerung deines Bereichs: Budgets, Termine, Qualität, Nachträge. Nach der Einarbeitung entscheidest du im vereinbarten Rahmen ohne Rücksprache. Die Kundenbeziehung. Du sprichst selbst mit den Gewässerverantwortlichen in Städten und Verbänden, schreibst Angebote, verhandelst und holst Folgeaufträge. Der Teil, für den uns heute die Zeit fehlt: KI-gestütztes Arbeiten in Prozesse einbauen, die halten. Projektstandards, Vorlagen, Qualitätssicherung, Wer das kann, prägt hier die nächsten Jahre. Was du mitbringst Führungserfahrung. Du hast mehrere Jahre eigenständig Projekte in Flussbau, Ingenieurbau, Wasserwirtschaft oder Regenwassermanagement geleitet und dabei Verantwortung für Menschen übernommen. Du weißt, wie man Aufgaben verteilt, Menschen entwickelt, Konflikte klärt und Entscheidungen auch dann trägt, wenn sie unbequem sind. Du führst gern. Es macht dir Spaß, wenn dein Team besser wird, nicht nur, wenn dein Projekt gut läuft. Gespräche mit deinen Leuten siehst du als Teil deiner Arbeit, nicht als Unterbrechung. Begeisterte Kunden sind dein Maßstab. Ein Studium im Bereich Bauingenieurwesen / Wasserbau, Landschaftsarchitektur, Umwelt- oder Landschaftsplanung oder etwas Vergleichbares. HOAI sitzt, Baustelle ist dir vertraut, und im Vergaberecht (VgV, UVgO, VOB/A) kennst du dich sicher aus, als Bieter wie bei der Vorbereitung von Bauvergaben. Praktische KI-Erfahrung. Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge bereits im Arbeitsalltag, etwa für Recherche, Texte, Auswertungen oder Angebote, kennst ihre Grenzen und hast Lust, das mit deinem Team weiterzuentwickeln. Naturnahen Wasserbau und Ingenieurbiologie musst du nicht mitbringen. Das ist unser Kernwissen, und wir bringen es dir bei. Dafür nehmen wir uns Zeit und planen es ein. Was du bekommst Entscheidungen, die du triffst, statt Entscheidungen, die du vorbereitest. 60.000 bis 70.000 Euro, je nach Erfahrung. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, an ein bis zwei Tagen pro Woche im Homeoffice zu arbeiten. Fortbildung, die wir bezahlen und für die du Arbeitszeit bekommst. Ein Büro, das wächst. Wir gehen in die DACH-Region. Das schafft Aufgaben, die es heute noch nicht gibt. Eine unternehmerische Perspektive: Wenn die Zusammenarbeit trägt, kannst du dich schrittweise am Unternehmen beteiligen. Warum es diese Stelle gibt Wir wachsen. Dafür bauen wir unseren Führungskreis aus und besetzen eine weitere Teamleitung in Vollzeit. Du kommst nicht in ein fertiges Team, sondern in eines, das gerade neu sortiert und erweitert wird. Wer darin die Chance sieht, ist hier richtig. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Executive Assistant (PSA-3)
description: United Nations University (UNU) The United Nations University (UNU) is a global think tank and postgraduate teaching organization within the United Nations System. UNU engages in policy-relevant research, capacity development, and knowledge dissemination in furtherance of the purposes and principles of the United Nations. The work of UNU contributes to solving pressing global problems that are the concern of the United Nations and its Member States. For the past five decades, UNU has been a source of impartial research on sustainability, human security, and economic development. With hundreds of researchers working at institutes in 12 countries, UNU's expertise spans the full breadth of the 17 Sustainable Development Goals, generating policy-relevant knowledge to effect positive global change. UNU collaborates closely with other UN entities and leading research institutions across the globe. For more information, please visit http://unu.edu . The United Nations University Vice-Rectorate in Europe (UNU-VIE ), established in 2007 in Bonn, Germany, is one of two UNU Vice-Rectorates and the only one located in Europe. It supports the institutional development of UNU, facilitates collaboration across UNU and the UN, as well as fosters strategic partnerships - particularly with the Global South - and shares knowledge and expertise through the development of joint activities and projects. In addition, UNU-VIE conducts frontier research reinforcing existing UNU programming and supporting the implementation of key UN priorities. More information about UNU-VIE can be found here: https://unu.edu/vie. . Responsibilities Under the authority of the Vice-Rector in Europe and Director of UNU-EHS and the direct supervision of the Head of the Executive Office & Special Assistant to the Vice-Rector and Director of UNU-EHS, the incumbent will be entrusted with the following tasks: 1. Manage appointments and mission travel for the Vice-Rector/Director of UNU-EHS and Deputy Director, if required Manage the calendar of the Vice-Rector/Director, and Deputy Director, as requested, including scheduling internal and external appointments; Welcome and assist visitors to the Office of the Vice-Rector/Director, liaising with UN Security; Coordinate official travel and accommodation arrangements in accordance with applicable UN and UNU rules and procedures. 2. Support internal and external communications Serve as a communication focal point for relevant UNU offices, UN agencies and external stakeholders in Bonn and internationally; Screen telephone calls/enquiries/requests and route them as appropriate; Monitor the institutional functional mailboxes, responding to enquiries and forwarding as appropriate; Prepare correspondence, reports and meeting minutes in English, German and other UN languages if required; Prepare presentations, handouts, and statistics as required. 3. Support logistical arrangements for institutional meetings and events Support the organization of major academic and administrative events including managing the booking of accommodation, hospitality, and travel to and from Bonn; Support the identification of possible venues on and off campus for the respective events; Manage the booking of UNU Bonn’s conference and meeting rooms and respond to participant requests. 4. Provide support with general office administration Maintain institutional archives and filing systems; Update and maintain an overview of all institutional contacts; Procure office supplies for the Office of the Vice-Rector/Director; Assist in identifying and liaising with potential vendors for Executive Office events, inter alia. 5. Perform other duties as assigned by supervisor Key Performance Indicators Timely and accurate coordination of calendars, appointments and official travel arrangements; Timely response to internal and external enquiries, including an appropriate choice of language to the respective audience; Accurate, clear and timely preparation of correspondence/written documents, such as letters, briefing notes, meeting minutes, ppt presentations and others; Effective assistance with logistical arrangements for meetings and institutional events; Timely updating, completeness and accuracy of institutional archives and the contact database, including records of key partners, key stakeholders and other relevant institutional contacts; Timely procurement of supplies and vendors. Competencies Values: Inclusion - Take action to create an environment of dignity and respect for all, regardless of age, culture, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, geography, grade, language, nationality, racial identity, religion, sex, sex characteristics, sexual orientation, social origin or any other aspect of identity; Integrity - Act ethically, demonstrating the standards of conduct of the United Nations and taking prompt action in case of witnessing unprofessional or unethical behaviour, or any other breach of UN standards; Humility - Demonstrate self-awareness and willingness to learn from others; Humanity - Act according to the purposes of the United Nations: peace, dignity and equality on a healthy planet. Behaviours: Connect and Collaborate - Build positive relationships with others to advance the work of the United Nations and work coherently as One UN; Analyse and Plan - Seek out and use data from a wide range of sources to understand problems, inform decision-making, propose evidence-based solutions and plan action; Deliver Results with Positive Impact - Hold oneself and others accountable for delivering results and making a positive difference to the people and causes that the United Nations serves; Learn and Develop - Pursue own learning and development and contribute to the learning and development of others; Adapt and Innovate - Demonstrate flexibility, agility and the ability to think and act in novel ways. 1) Education and certification: Secondary education diploma OR First degree (Bachelor’s degree or equivalent) in International Management/Business Assistant, Business Communication, International Relations, European Secretarial Studies, Office Management, or related field. 2) Required qualifications and experience: For candidates with a secondary education diploma, at least four (4) years of relevant experience in office, secretarial or administrative support is required. For candidates with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a relevant field, at least three (3) years of relevant experience is required. Experience in an international or multi-ethnic working environment is required; Experience of drafting written documents (e.g. presentations, briefings, meeting minutes) is required; Proficiency in Microsoft applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access is required. 3) Desired qualifications and experience: Experience in event management; Knowledge of contact databases/knowledge management systems; Strong ability to establish priorities, work within tight timelines and multi-task; excellent organizational skills; strong interpersonal skills; resilience; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and professionally with internal and external stakeholders. 4) Language Requirements: Fluency in English and German, both oral and written, is required; Knowledge of another UN official working language is an asset. Remuneration The successful candidate will be employed under a national PSA contract. UNU offers an attractive compensation package including an annual net salary, commensurate with the experience and qualifications of the candidate. Benefits include 30 days annual leave and a health insurance scheme. UNU is not liable for any taxes that may be levied on the remuneration you receive under this contract. Payment of any such taxes remains the sole responsibility of PSA holders. Duration of contract The duration of the initial contract is 1 year. This is Personnel Service Agreement (PSA) contract with UNU, with the possibility for renewal subject to requirements and satisfactory work performance. The combined duration on a PSA contract with UNU may not exceed six (6) years. The mandatory age of retirement for PSA holders is 65 years. This post is open to applicants from all countries and UNU will aid the successful applicant in securing a work visa for Germany, as necessary. raw.title: Senior Executive Assistant (PSA-3)
raw.description:
United Nations University (UNU)

The United Nations University (UNU) is a global think tank and postgraduate teaching organization within the United Nations System. UNU engages in policy-relevant research, capacity development, and knowledge dissemination in furtherance of the purposes and principles of the United Nations. The work of UNU contributes to solving pressing global problems that are the concern of the United Nations and its Member States. 

For the past five decades, UNU has been a source of impartial research on sustainability, human security, and economic development. With hundreds of researchers working at institutes in 12 countries, UNU's expertise spans the full breadth of the 17 Sustainable Development Goals, generating policy-relevant knowledge to effect positive global change. UNU collaborates closely with other UN entities and leading research institutions across the globe. For more information, please visit http://unu.edu.

The United Nations University Vice-Rectorate in Europe (UNU-VIE), established in 2007 in Bonn, Germany, is one of two UNU Vice-Rectorates and the only one located in Europe. It supports the institutional development of UNU, facilitates collaboration across UNU and the UN, as well as fosters strategic partnerships - particularly with the Global South - and shares knowledge and expertise through the development of joint activities and projects. In addition, UNU-VIE conducts frontier research reinforcing existing UNU programming and supporting the implementation of key UN priorities. More information about UNU-VIE can be found here: https://unu.edu/vie.

.

Responsibilities

Under the authority of the Vice-Rector in Europe and Director of UNU-EHS and the direct supervision of the Head of the Executive Office & Special Assistant to the Vice-Rector and Director of UNU-EHS, the incumbent will be entrusted with the following tasks:

1.  Manage appointments and mission travel for the Vice-Rector/Director of UNU-EHS and Deputy Director, if required

  • Manage the calendar of the Vice-Rector/Director, and Deputy Director, as requested, including scheduling internal and external appointments;

  • Welcome and assist visitors to the Office of the Vice-Rector/Director, liaising with UN Security;

  • Coordinate official travel and accommodation arrangements in accordance with applicable UN and UNU rules and procedures.

 

2.  Support internal and external communications

  • Serve as a communication focal point for relevant UNU offices, UN agencies and external stakeholders in Bonn and internationally;

  • Screen telephone calls/enquiries/requests and route them as appropriate;

  • Monitor the institutional functional mailboxes, responding to enquiries and forwarding as appropriate;

  • Prepare correspondence, reports and meeting minutes in English, German and other UN languages if required;

  • Prepare presentations, handouts, and statistics as required.

3.    Support logistical arrangements for institutional meetings and events

  • Support the organization of major academic and administrative events including managing the booking of accommodation, hospitality, and travel to and from Bonn;

  • Support the identification of possible venues on and off campus for the respective events;

  • Manage the booking of UNU Bonn’s conference and meeting rooms and respond to participant requests.

4.     Provide support with general office administration

  • Maintain institutional archives and filing systems;

  • Update and maintain an overview of all institutional contacts;

  • Procure office supplies for the Office of the Vice-Rector/Director;

  • Assist in identifying and liaising with potential vendors for Executive Office events, inter alia.

 

5.     Perform other duties as assigned by supervisor

Key Performance Indicators

  • Timely and accurate coordination of calendars, appointments and official travel arrangements;

  • Timely response to internal and external enquiries, including an appropriate choice of language to the respective audience;

  • Accurate, clear and timely preparation of correspondence/written documents, such as letters, briefing notes, meeting minutes, ppt presentations and others;

  • Effective assistance with logistical arrangements for meetings and institutional events;

  • Timely updating, completeness and accuracy of institutional archives and the contact database, including records of key partners, key stakeholders and other relevant institutional contacts;

  • Timely procurement of supplies and vendors.

Competencies

Values:

  • Inclusion - Take action to create an environment of dignity and respect for all, regardless of age, culture, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, geography, grade, language, nationality, racial identity, religion, sex, sex characteristics, sexual orientation, social origin or any other aspect of identity;

  • Integrity - Act ethically, demonstrating the standards of conduct of the United Nations and taking prompt action in case of witnessing unprofessional or unethical behaviour, or any other breach of UN standards;

  • Humility - Demonstrate self-awareness and willingness to learn from others;

  • Humanity - Act according to the purposes of the United Nations: peace, dignity and equality on a healthy planet.

Behaviours:

  • Connect and Collaborate - Build positive relationships with others to advance the work of the United Nations and work coherently as One UN;

  • Analyse and Plan - Seek out and use data from a wide range of sources to understand problems, inform decision-making, propose evidence-based solutions and plan action;

  • Deliver Results with Positive Impact - Hold oneself and others accountable for delivering results and making a positive difference to the people and causes that the United Nations serves;

  • Learn and Develop - Pursue own learning and development and contribute to the learning and development of others;

  • Adapt and Innovate - Demonstrate flexibility, agility and the ability to think and act in novel ways.



1) Education and certification:

Secondary education diploma OR First degree (Bachelor’s degree or equivalent) in International Management/Business Assistant, Business Communication, International Relations, European Secretarial Studies, Office Management, or related field.

2) Required qualifications and experience:      

  • For candidates with a secondary education diploma, at least four (4) years of relevant experience in office, secretarial or administrative support is required. For candidates with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a relevant field, at least three (3) years of relevant experience is required. Experience in an international or multi-ethnic working environment is required;

  • Experience of drafting written documents (e.g. presentations, briefings, meeting minutes) is required;

  • Proficiency in Microsoft applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access is required.

3) Desired qualifications and experience:

  • Experience in event management;

  • Knowledge of contact databases/knowledge management systems;

  • Strong ability to establish priorities, work within tight timelines and multi-task; excellent organizational skills; strong interpersonal skills; resilience;

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and professionally with internal and external stakeholders.

4) Language Requirements:

  • Fluency in English and German, both oral and written, is required;

  • Knowledge of another UN official working language is an asset.

Remuneration

The successful candidate will be employed under a national PSA contract. UNU offers an attractive compensation package including an annual net salary, commensurate with the experience and qualifications of the candidate. Benefits include 30 days annual leave and a health insurance scheme.

UNU is not liable for any taxes that may be levied on the remuneration you receive under this contract. Payment of any such taxes remains the sole responsibility of PSA holders.


Duration of contract

The duration of the initial contract is 1 year. This is Personnel Service Agreement (PSA) contract with UNU, with the possibility for renewal subject to requirements and satisfactory work performance. The combined duration on a PSA contract with UNU may not exceed six (6) years. The mandatory age of retirement for PSA holders is 65 years.  This post is open to applicants from all countries and UNU will aid the
successful applicant in securing a work visa for Germany, as necessary. It is, however, a locally recruited post and no relocation allowances
apply. The duty station will be Bonn, Germany.


Starting date: As soon as possible


How to Apply

To apply to UNU, you will not need an account. Instead, we ask that you:

  • Fill out the UNU P11 Form (please avoid using similar forms provided by other United Nations organisations);

  • Provide a motivation statement (in the P11 form);

  • Provide a CV (max. 2 pages);

  • Provide a cover letter (max. 1 page) setting out how the qualifications and experience match the requirements of the position;

  • Answer a few questions that are tailored to the position; and

  • apply via the apply link;

You may wish to refer to the UN Values and Behaviours Framework for more information.


Application Deadline: 03 December 2026.

Submissions must be received by 23:59 CET on the deadline; late entries will not be accepted.


Assessment

Evaluation of qualified candidates may include an assessment exercise which may be followed by a competency-based interview, background checks, and references.


Special Notice

PSA holders are neither “staff members” under the Staff Regulations and Rules of the United Nations nor “officials” for the purpose of the Convention on the Privileges and Immunities of the United Nations (1946). They are subject to the Rector's authority and may be assigned to any of the activities or offices of the United Nations University. The Rector reserves the right to appoint a candidate at a level below that advertised. UNU is committed to diversity and inclusion within its workforce, and encourages all candidates, irrespective of gender, nationality, religious and ethnic backgrounds, including persons living with disabilities to apply and become part of the organisation. Applications from developing countries, and from women are strongly encouraged. Eligible internal applicants are also encouraged to apply. UNU has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNU, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. If you have supervisory function, you need to have awareness on gender related issues.


Information about UNU rosters

UNU reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNU at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.


Scam Warning

UNU does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process. Should you receive a solicitation for the payment of a fee, please disregard it. Furthermore, please note that emblems, logos, names and addresses are easily copied and reproduced. description: Du lebst auf TikTok, Instagram und YouTube? Canva, CapCut, ChatGPT hast immer im Einsatz? Du siehst ein Reel und weißt sofort, warum es funktioniert – und wie Du es besser gemacht hättest? Super. Wir suchen für Social Media & Content-Marketing eine Werkstudentin bzw. einen Werkstudenten in unserer Werbeagentur in Passau (vor Ort). Bitte ausschließlich digitale Bewerbungen; postalische Bewerbungen werden nicht berücksichtigt oder zurückgesandt. — Bewerbungen werden auf Deutsch entgegengenommen. Aufgaben Reels, Shorts und TikToks konzipieren, drehen, schneiden und veröffentlichen – von der Idee bis zum fertigen Post. Pins, Grafiken und Kurzvideos für Instagram, TikTok, YouTube und Pinterest aufbereiten. Content für Webseiten, Social Media und KI-Systeme erstellen und optimieren. Trends, Sounds und Formate beobachten und für unsere Kunden übersetzen. Verstehen, warum ein Video läuft und ein anderes nicht – und daraus lernen (ja, ein bisschen Zahlen gucken gehört dazu). Bestehende Inhalte analysieren und hinsichtlich Reichweite, Interaktionen und Performance verbessern. KI-Tools sinnvoll zur Ideenfindung, Recherche und Content-Produktion einsetzen. Mit superlieben Kunden kommunizieren oder mal was wegfuttern, wenn die vor Freude was vorbeibringen. Qualifikation Irgendwas mit Medien, Marketing oder Gestaltung: Du bist ordentlich immatrikuliert an einer (Fach-)Hochschule in Passau oder Umgebung wie Deggendorf, Hagenberg, Linz. Gerne Medien und Kommunikation (MuK), Journalistik und Strategische Kommunikation (JoKo), Medientechnik, Mediengestaltung/-produktion oder irgendwas mit Schwerpunkt Marketing. Muss: Du bist selbst aktiv auf TikTok, Instagram, YouTube & Co. – und verstehst, was dort gerade läuft. Du hast Spaß daran, Inhalte zu erstellen, die Menschen wirklich anschauen, und zu analysieren, was warum trendet. Canva, CapCut, ChatGPT, Claude oder Gemini sind deine Werkzeuge. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <p>As a Security Engineer within the Security Operations team, you will help design, build, and continuously improve the technical capabilities that underpin how we detect, investigate, and respond to threats. You will work at the intersection of engineering and operations — helping turn security problems into scalable, automated solutions. Your core responsibilities will be to:</p> <ul> <li>Alert Investigation &amp; Triage: Investigate and triage security alerts from across our detection tooling, analysing logs, endpoint, identity, cloud, and network telemetry to determine impact and root cause. Help with evidence collection and preservation, timeline reconstruction, containment, and root cause analysis, and contribute to post-incident reviews that turn lessons learned into improved detections and tooling.</li> <li>SIEM Engineering: Contribute to the engineering of our SIEM platform, including onboarding and normalising log sources, building and maintaining parsers, and supporting high-fidelity data pipelines that underpin detection and investigation. Help improve log coverage, data quality, and platform performance.</li> <li>Detection Engineering: Help develop and maintain a library of high-quality detections using a Detection as Code methodology — working with version control, peer review, and automated testing pipelines. Map detections to the MITRE ATT&amp;CK framework and contribute to improving coverage, precision, and resilience against evasion.</li> <li>AI-Augmented Security Operations: Help explore and apply AI and machine learning to enhance security operations capabilities — including alert triage, incident response acceleration, threat intelligence analysis, threat hunting, and the enrichment and prioritisation of detection content. Contribute to evaluating emerging AI tooling and embedding it responsibly into team workflows.</li> <li>Threat Intelligence Integration: Help consume and operationalise threat intelligence from internal and external sources, integrating indicators and adversary context into detection logic, response playbooks, and hunting activities. Work with threat intelligence feeds and platforms to support a timely and structured flow of actionable intelligence into security operations.</li> <li>Threat Hunting: Take part in proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunts across the environment to identify attacker activity that evades existing detections. Document and share findings in a structured way, using hunt outcomes to inform and improve detection engineering and tooling.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring to the role:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a technically capable security professional with hands-on experience in security operations. Experience integrating these tools to support detection, investigation, and response workflows.</li> <li>Threat Intelligence &amp; Threat Hunting: Experience working with threat intelligence platforms and feeds, and integrating intelligence into security tooling, detection logic, and operational processes.
