title: Senior Medical Writer (UK Based/US Position)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.</p> <p>Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.</p> <p>Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.</p></div><h2><strong>Senior Medical Writer&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p><strong>Please note: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the legal right to work in the UK. If you do not meet this requirement, please do not apply. This is a hybrid position and is not a fully remote role.</strong></p> <p>Our <strong>Senior Medical Writers</strong> are responsible for driving day-to-day project delivery (with support from others) within an account in order to create outstanding medical content across a variety of therapy areas. This position is ideal for an experienced writer who has a passion for scientific and medical developments, a keen interest in AI, and who enjoys tackling new problems, interacting with clients, and mentoring internal team members.</p> <p><span data-teams="true"><em><strong>This role is based in the UK and employed under a UK contract of employment, with contractual working hours of 40 hours per week, but works as part of teams supporting US business and clients. The role works closely with US-based colleagues and may have day-to-day line management from leaders supporting US business. As for any role in Real Chemistry, reasonable flexibility to work across US and other time zones will be required depending on business need.</strong></em></span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Scientific knowledge:</strong> <ul> <li>Confidently steps into new therapeutic areas</li> <li>Starting to lead discussions with clients and external experts on therapy area, drivers which influence treatment decision-making and patient pathways</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Strategic knowledge:</strong> Helps to lead meetings and strategic discussions with clients</li> <li><strong>AI</strong> <ul> <li>Proactively utilizes a broad range of AI solutions to streamline complex projects, with support from others</li> <li>Evaluates and implements AI-driven solutions to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of projects, identifying opportunities for improvement and collaborating with team members to optimize project delivery</li> <li>Provides guidance and training to team members on best practice</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Project ownership:</strong> <ul> <li>Leads content delivery for complex projects with supervision from senior team, delegating to AMW/MWs as needed and where appropriate to ensure timely execution to a high standard</li> <li>Skilled in achieving communications objectives by employing a broad range of channels and formats</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Project development: </strong> <ul> <li>Interrogates briefs from clients/internal teams and proactively flags any queries or potential issues</li> <li>Applies critical thinking skills towards a project brief to achieve deliverables in a timely and efficient manner</li> <li>Provides a proactive, solution-focused approach towards resolving queries, and addressing feedback</li> <li>Initiates discussions with Account Teams regarding potential barriers to successful project completion that may arise</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Editorial:</strong> <ul> <li>Develops compelling narratives from complex information</li> <li>Structures and writes novel projects that may not have been executed previously</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Quality control:</strong> <ul> <li>Takes responsibility for overall quality of deliverables with supervision from senior team</li> <li>Reviews JMWs’ work for adherence to brief, client objectives and quality of writing, providing constructive feedback</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>On site: </strong>Leads elements of the on-site programme across a variety of events with support from others</li> <li><strong>Client liaison: </strong>Leads scientific discussion with clients and external experts as appropriate to capture briefs, resolve queries, and progress scientific content development in timely and efficient manner</li> <li><strong>Growth and new business</strong> <ul> <li>Supports development of scientific content for new therapeutic areas for new business</li> <li>Proactively identifies new business opportunities with new and existing clients</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Project management: </strong>Provides timely and accurate communication to accounts team on writer hours, and project progress</li> <li><strong>Teamwork</strong>: Trains/mentors junior writers on account-specific therapy area knowledge and processes</li> </ul> <h2>Qualifications and skills</h2> <ul> <li>You should bring a strong scientific background with a degree in a scientific or medical discipline (post-graduate degree preferred). Collaboration</strong></p> <p>• Lead, motivate and support your team (two Trade Marketing Managers and two Retail Marketing Executives across the five pureplay channels, plus a dotted-line Manager), leading from a place of empathy, owning individual development plans, setting clear objectives and building an unstoppable team.</p> <p>• Work closely with the other vertical leads, and partner end-to-end with Sales, Brand/Category Marketing, SSnA, Studio, Brand Media, IMC and Retail Excellence (Field &amp; title: Portfolio Risk and Treasury Manager
description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent . We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites , with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far. We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy. The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards , came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100 . Learn more about us on our website . 🎙️ The Role We're hiring a Portfolio Risk and Treasury Manager. This role reports directly to the CFO and sits in our Finance team. You will be tem's first dedicated hire in risk oversight and treasury, independent of the teams whose positions and processes you oversee and challenge. It's a solo, individual-contributor role for now: no team to manage, but real ownership of a complex, cross-functional, load-bearing area that touches our pricing and trading engine, FP&A, cash management and our commercial and people teams, and that increasingly matters to how investors, the board and funding partners see tem's risk maturity. tem doesn't yet have anyone who owns liquidity as a discipline, or a second line of defence on risk. Growth in our business is capital-intensive: every collateral demand, margin call, commission payment and new market adds to the cash we need to carry, and the cost of that cash is rarely visible in the decisions that create it. You will build that capability from scratch, bringing treasury and independent risk oversight together, so that tem's risk and liquidity management stands on its own rather than marking its own homework. In your first 12 months, you might: Stand up tem's second line risk function: independent oversight and challenge of our first line risk processes, with risk appetite and limits that are set, monitored and acted on. Build the liquidity models tem runs on, short and long term: working capital, collateral, margin calls, cash runway, and the credit facilities and letters of credit behind them. Put cost of capital into our commercial pricing decisions, so the liquidity a deal consumes is visible at the moment the deal is made. Work with the CFO to secure liquidity provision that scales ahead of the business and new markets. Replace manual portfolio reconciliation with automation, and build our operational risk framework from the ground up. 🚀 Responsibilities Second line oversight: establish and run independent oversight and challenge of tem's first line risk processes across trading and portfolio activity, input into risk appetite and the setting of notional and VaR limits, and monitor ongoing adherence. Liquidity modelling: build and maintain short-term (cash runway, margin call forecasting) and long-term (growth and new market funding) liquidity models, covering generator collateral, hedging counterparty collateral, variation margin, credit facilities and letters of credit. Working capital: own working capital efficiency as a measured, targeted discipline rather than a byproduct of other teams' decisions, working closely with Finance's cash management team. Cost of capital and pricing: develop tem's cost of capital framework, make it usable in pricing, give our pricing and commercial teams the cost of capital impact of their decisions, and challenge decisions that consume liquidity without adequate return. Liquidity risk: model liquidity risk from volume and price variance on energy volumes, run stress scenarios and report liquidity headroom against them. Liquidity supply and funding: work with the CFO to engage lenders, credit facility providers and collateral and letter of credit providers, keep liquidity provision ahead of the business with early visibility of when new capacity is needed, and prepare liquidity and risk materials for funding partners, investors and the board. Operational risk: build tem's operational risk framework from the ground up, including incident reporting and management, and drive automation of portfolio data reconciliation, from hedge contracts and confirmations through to hedge settlement and cash reconciliation with Finance. raw.description:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent.

We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites, with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far.

We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🎙️ The Role

We're hiring a Portfolio Risk and Treasury Manager.

This role reports directly to the CFO and sits in our Finance team. You will be tem's first dedicated hire in risk oversight and treasury, independent of the teams whose positions and processes you oversee and challenge. It's a solo, individual-contributor role for now: no team to manage, but real ownership of a complex, cross-functional, load-bearing area that touches our pricing and trading engine, FP&A, cash management and our commercial and people teams, and that increasingly matters to how investors, the board and funding partners see tem's risk maturity.

tem doesn't yet have anyone who owns liquidity as a discipline, or a second line of defence on risk. Growth in our business is capital-intensive: every collateral demand, margin call, commission payment and new market adds to the cash we need to carry, and the cost of that cash is rarely visible in the decisions that create it. You will build that capability from scratch, bringing treasury and independent risk oversight together, so that tem's risk and liquidity management stands on its own rather than marking its own homework.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Stand up tem's second line risk function: independent oversight and challenge of our first line risk processes, with risk appetite and limits that are set, monitored and acted on.

  • Build the liquidity models tem runs on, short and long term: working capital, collateral, margin calls, cash runway, and the credit facilities and letters of credit behind them.

  • Put cost of capital into our commercial pricing decisions, so the liquidity a deal consumes is visible at the moment the deal is made.

  • Work with the CFO to secure liquidity provision that scales ahead of the business and new markets.

  • Replace manual portfolio reconciliation with automation, and build our operational risk framework from the ground up.

🚀 Responsibilities

  • Second line oversight: establish and run independent oversight and challenge of tem's first line risk processes across trading and portfolio activity, input into risk appetite and the setting of notional and VaR limits, and monitor ongoing adherence.

  • Liquidity modelling: build and maintain short-term (cash runway, margin call forecasting) and long-term (growth and new market funding) liquidity models, covering generator collateral, hedging counterparty collateral, variation margin, credit facilities and letters of credit.

  • Working capital: own working capital efficiency as a measured, targeted discipline rather than a byproduct of other teams' decisions, working closely with Finance's cash management team.

  • Cost of capital and pricing: develop tem's cost of capital framework, make it usable in pricing, give our pricing and commercial teams the cost of capital impact of their decisions, and challenge decisions that consume liquidity without adequate return.

  • Liquidity risk: model liquidity risk from volume and price variance on energy volumes, run stress scenarios and report liquidity headroom against them.

  • Liquidity supply and funding: work with the CFO to engage lenders, credit facility providers and collateral and letter of credit providers, keep liquidity provision ahead of the business with early visibility of when new capacity is needed, and prepare liquidity and risk materials for funding partners, investors and the board.

  • Operational risk: build tem's operational risk framework from the ground up, including incident reporting and management, and drive automation of portfolio data reconciliation, from hedge contracts and confirmations through to hedge settlement and cash reconciliation with Finance.

  • Reporting and stakeholders: build automated, async-first risk reporting (dashboards and written updates by default, a live sync only when something needs real-time discussion), represent tem with hedging and generator counterparties and funding partners, and communicate risk and liquidity positions clearly to leadership.

🎯 Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Risk management or treasury experience from a fintech, quant trading or other digital-native environment: modern, tech-first risk practices rather than legacy, spreadsheet-driven ones.

  • Knowledge of energy markets, energy trading or energy risk management and portfolio balancing.

  • Liquidity modelling experience: working capital, collateral and margin dynamics, and cash forecasting over short and long horizons.

  • Risk modelling experience, including VaR and stress testing, and an understanding of cost of capital and how to translate it into commercial decisions.

  • Data literate: comfortable working with and drawing conclusions from portfolio and risk data.

  • Genuinely curious and intellectually sharp (this is a thinking role, not a process-running one), and confident communicating with senior stakeholders, external counterparties and funding partners.

Desirable

  • Experience raising or managing credit facilities, letters of credit or other trade finance.

  • Experience of US electricity markets.

  • Operational risk experience, or familiarity with the Ofgem regulatory environment.

  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of day-to-day work. No coding or SQL required.

✨ Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,400 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR170 per month for wellbeing.

🗣️ Interview Process

  • First call with our Talent Team.

  • Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager.

  • Technical Interview with the Team (90 mins). You'll meet with potential peers in this session and will discuss how you would model and stress tem's liquidity, where you would set and monitor risk limits, and how you would make cost of capital usable in pricing decisions, including a practical exercise.

  • Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As General Manager of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

About the Role:

As a Sr. Project Manager at MustardSeed, you will be contributing to end-to-end project delivery within specified timeframes, budgets, and quality standards. As an experienced project manager already, you will collaborate closely with stakeholders to ensure the best possible outcomes, steering multidisciplinary teams towards common goals.

 

The Sr. Project Manager is the chief “make sure it happens – and happens right” person on the project and has the overall responsibility for ensuring that the outputs from each project phase – the initiation, planning, execution and closing phases – are delivered according to the requirements established and approved for that phase, and that these outputs are consistent across all phases.

 

You will contribute to a wide variety of different projects while maintaining a focus on project management best practices and stakeholder satisfaction.

 

Previous projects our team has facilitated include but are not limited to creating a robust integrated master schedule (IMS) for an upcoming clinical trial, identifying, and eliminating bottlenecks in a new product introduction (NPI) process, completing a transformative overhaul of a client’s product lifecycle management (PLM) process, ensuring the successful delivery of a newly acquired software, overhauling a client’s supply chain management (SCM) practices.

 

If you are highly skilled and enjoy challenging, important work while retaining the flexibility your life needs, we would like to talk to you!

 

Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

  • Ensure that communication within and between organizations involved in the various phases is occurring effectively, and that management and other stakeholders are kept informed of progress, as necessary.

  • Develop a detailed project plan to monitor and track progress while managing changes to project scope, project schedule, and project cost.

  • Track project performance, specifically to analyze the successful completion of short and long-term goals.

  • Meet budgetary objectives and adjust project constraints based on financial analysis.

 

Skills Required:

  • Proven track record of delivery, ideally with at least 5 years in a project management role.

  • Ability to think strategically and tactically about product, technical, and cross-functional issues.

  • Excellent client-facing and internal verbal and written communication skills.

  • High-caliber organizational skills (e.g., attention to detail, multitasking, etc.).

  • Proven leadership and experience in project management.

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) / Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus.

 

Additional Information:

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

 

Compensation Range: £60,000 to £75,000/annually

MustardSeed is a project management consulting firm. Our project managers are embedded within our clients' organizations to lead and support critical initiatives across multiple industries. The Role Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one. You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area. What You’ll Own Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures. Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite. Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients. Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity. Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments. File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR. Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board. Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest. Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters. Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027. Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows. What We’re Looking For Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution. Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale. Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes. Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections. Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast. Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools. Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues. Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators. A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder. Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania. Nice to Have Lithuanian language ability. An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT. Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions. Experience with clients across several EEA countries. CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification. This Role Is Not For People who only want to attend meetings. Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business. People who say no without offering a compliant way forward. People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions. Location This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week. You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. raw.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Responsable enquêtes & plaidoyer
description: Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance. Nous avons été distingués pour notre exclusion des énergies fossiles par Reclaim Finance, bank.green, Bank for Good ou encore Moralscore. Green-Got est aussi lauréat de l'Impact 40 depuis 3 années consécutives. Depuis cinq ans, nous montrons où va l'argent. Nos membres ont sorti 300 millions d'euros des grandes banques. Notre mission est de définir de nouveaux standards pour le secteur financier, alignés avec la science, et non pas les intérêts des industries fossiles. Pourquoi ce recrutement ? Les banques traditionnelles ont des lobbyistes. Ils défendent leurs profits et les industries qu'elles financent. Les citoyens, eux, n'en ont jamais eu. C'est désormais le cas. Pendant plusieurs mois, nous avons enquêté sur le financement des pesticides par les banques françaises. Mais dénoncer ne suffit pas : la prochaine étape, c'est la loi. Nous recrutons la personne qui enquêtera à nos côtés, dévoilera ce que le système préfère laisser dans l'ombre et proposera des solutions concrètes pour changer les règles. Elle racontera chaque étape du combat à nos membres, en toute transparence. Missions Ton travail tient en trois verbes : enquêter, dévoiler, proposer. Tu portes 2 à 3 grandes campagnes par an, de la première piste jusqu'au texte de loi, et tu les incarnes. 1. Enquêter Faire la veille de l'actualité politique, réglementaire et scientifique (Parlement européen, Assemblée nationale, comitologie, ONG), et nourrir l'équipe Média pour nos contenus réactifs. Repérer les sujets de nos grandes campagnes de mobilisation et les valider avec nous : fludioxonyl, TotalEnergies financé par les Livrets A . 2. Dévoiler Mener les recherches sur les campagnes validées. Ce n'est pas de la réaction à chaud : ce sont 2 à 3 combats de fond par an. Creuser les rapports, les bilans et les sources primaires que personne ne lit, et en sortir des informations inédites . Trouver les angles : quelles personnes interroger (un agriculteur, une famille touchée), comment les contacter, quels contenus en tirer avec l'équipe Média. Incarner l'enquête pendant qu'elle se fait, face caméra et sur le terrain : Prendre la parole face caméra (vidéos, lives, interventions médias) et partager régulièrement où en est le combat. Répondre aux commentaires sur tes sujets et publier dans l' onglet Communauté de l'app. Tu vois comment nos membres réagissent, et cela nourrit tes prochaines enquêtes. 3. Proposer : plaidoyer et lobbying institutionnel Construire la feuille de route plaidoyer à partir de nos enquêtes : quelles demandes, auprès de quelles institutions, avec quel calendrier. Évaluer la faisabilité juridique et politique des leviers possibles : interdire certaines substances, encadrer ou interdire les financements aux producteurs de pesticides, exiger la transparence sur la présence d'entreprises fossiles ou de pesticides dans les produits d'épargne. Repérer les fenêtres déjà ouvertes : renouvellements d'autorisation de substances, textes européens en discussion (Omnibus, décisions du SCoPAFF), propositions de loi, projets de loi de finances. Rédiger les notes de position, propositions d'amendements et argumentaires , toujours adossés à la science et à des données indépendantes. Cartographier et rencontrer les décideurs : Parlement européen , Commission européenne , Représentation permanente de la France , Assemblée nationale , Sénat , ministères, agences et régulateurs. Analyser leurs prises de position et leurs votes passés. Rester strictement apartisan : nos demandes s'appuient sur la science, pas sur un camp. Construire des coalitions avec les ONG, scientifiques, juristes et journalistes, et représenter Green-Got dans les coalitions françaises et européennes de la finance durable (Sustainable Banking Coalition/FEBEA, Impact France, Fair Finance). Une victoire collective reste collective : tes contacts doivent être dans toutes les ONG. Devenir à terme un visage récurrent : « votre lobbyiste à Bruxelles ». Compétences recherchées Indispensable Une expérience solide en plaidoyer, affaires publiques ou journalisme d'enquête : ONG, think tank, collaboration parlementaire, cabinet ministériel ou rédaction. Un flair d'enquêteur. Tu sais où chercher l'information que personne n'a sortie (bilans, comitologie, listes de vote, thèses), et tu la vérifies avant de l'affirmer. Une maîtrise en profondeur les deux arènes. Tu connais de l'intérieur le fonctionnement des institutions européennes (commissions, trilogues, comitologie) et du Parlement français (navette, amendements, PLF), et tu as déjà travaillé avec l'autre. Un réseau actif de parlementaires, collaborateurs, conseillers et ONG sur ces sujets. Une plume à deux registres : une note de position qui tient face à un juriste, un post LinkedIn qui tient face à un scroll. De l'aisance face caméra et avec les journalistes. Tu acceptes d'incarner un combat, dans le respect strict des faits. Un fibre en contenus : tu sais quels angles vont attirer l’attention, comment raconter des sujets compliqués… Un vrai plus Une culture scientifique et réglementaire sur la finance durable et la santé environnementale : taxonomie, SFDR, évaluation des risques, cadre européen d'autorisation des substances. Une expérience dans une ONG de finance climat, ou une connaissance de la régulation financière (règles prudentielles). Une expérience d'animation de coalitions. Profil recherché Green-Got est un employeur inclusif. Tous les profils qui se reconnaissent dans cette annonce sont les bienvenus, quels que soient leur parcours, leur genre ou leur origine. Tu vas chercher toi-même. Tu ne reprends pas les enquêtes des autres : tu remontes aux sources. Tu arrives avec un dossier. Pas seulement une dénonciation : ce qu'il faudrait changer, comment, et avec qui. Tu es crédible partout. Dans le bureau d'un conseiller ministériel comme dans une story Instagram. Tu tiens la distance. Le plaidoyer est lent et échoue souvent. Un échec bien raconté ne te fait pas peur : il prépare la suite. Tu es rigoureux (mais genre, vraiment). Une seule affirmation fragile ruinerait la crédibilité de toutes les autres. Chaque chiffre est sourcé, chaque victoire attribuée à sa juste part. Tu es owner. Tes réussites comme tes échecs t'appartiennent. Tu avances même quand c'est flou. Tu veux un impact réel. Changer les règles, pas seulement en parler. Le package Lieu : Paris, avec des déplacements réguliers. Contrat : CDI, statut cadre Arrivée : ASAP BSPCEs (equity) RTTs Mutuelle santé Alan Déplacements à Bruxelles pris en charge Une journée d'équipe tous les semestres Nous avons hâte de te rencontrer. description: Handicap International (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 59 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence. Aujourd'hui, nous avons 4000 employés dans le monde.   Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux premiers entretiens. Au sein de l’équipe communication de Handicap International France, vous participerez au développement et à l’animation des communautés de l’organisation sur les réseaux sociaux (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads, etc.), en lien étroit avec le community manager et le social media manager. Vous contribuerez à faire vivre les échanges avec les internautes, à identifier les sujets susceptibles de susciter leur intérêt et à adapter les prises de parole de l’association aux usages des différentes plateformes. Vous participerez à la recherche de nouvelles idées éditoriales, à la conception de formats adaptés aux réseaux sociaux et à la valorisation des actions de l’organisation auprès du grand public. Enfin, vous contribuerez au suivi des interactions et à l’analyse des performances des contenus afin de dégager des enseignements et de proposer des pistes d’amélioration. Ce stage vous permettra de découvrir les enjeux de l’animation de communautés numériques au sein d’une ONG internationale et de participer à des actions de communication visant à sensibiliser le public, encourager l’engagement citoyen et faire connaître les combats de Handicap International en faveur des droits des personnes handicapées et des populations vulnérables. Activité 1 : Développement et animation des communautés en ligne Participation à l’animation des espaces d’échange de Handicap International France sur les réseaux sociaux. Identification des sujets de conversation et des besoins de la communauté, suivi des interactions et contribution à la qualité des échanges avec les internautes. Activité 2 : Conception éditoriale et adaptation des contenus social media Contribution à la recherche d’idées et à la proposition de formats adaptés aux usages des différentes plateformes. Participation à la rédaction de publications, à la déclinaison de contenus existants et à la création de formats engageants en lien avec l’actualité, les campagnes et les missions de l’organisation. Activité 3 : Coordination opérationnelle de la diffusion social media Participation à la préparation et à l’organisation des publications : mise à jour du calendrier éditorial, adaptation des messages aux spécificités des plateformes, préparation des éléments nécessaires à leur diffusion et suivi de leur bonne mise en ligne via Agorapulse. Activité 4 : Veille des conversations numériques et suivi de l’engagement Observation des tendances, des pratiques des autres organisations et des discussions en ligne autour des thématiques portées par Handicap International. description: McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international. Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes. Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle. Vos missions Votre mission Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing) Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale. Vos principales responsabilités Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ; Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ; Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ; Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ; Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ; Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ; Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ; Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ; Tenir à jour la documentation interne ; Rédiger les comptes rendus d’opération (% de réussite, interventions et résolutions) quotidiens et mensuels Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures. Organisation du travail et horaires Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe. Horaires de journée, prises de poste tôt le matin et horaires de soirée ; À terme, horaires de nuit dans le cadre du développement aux États-Unis ; Travail régulier le week-end et certains jours fériés ; Répartition des plages de couverture entre les superviseurs selon un système de rotation. Actuellement, certaines opérations peuvent commencer dès 3 heures et se terminer jusqu’à 22 heures. Avec le développement de nos activités aux États-Unis, certaines plages de supervision pourront être réalisées pendant la nuit. L’organisation des rotations sera réalisée dans le respect du temps de travail annualisé, des temps de repos et des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Les heures de nuit, du dimanche et des jours fériés donneront lieu aux majorations ou compensations prévues au sein de l’entreprise. Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends. Anglais courant obligatoire, à l’oral comme à l’écrit. Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins deux ans en support client, assistance technique, supervision d’opérations, exploitation informatique, maintenance à distance ou gestion d’incidents est requise. La connaissance du secteur hippique constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Une formation aux solutions et aux procédures Mclloyd sera assurée en interne. Avantages Conditions proposées CDI à temps plein annualisé ; Majorations ou compensations applicables aux horaires concernés ; Poste exercé à 100 % en télétravail, exclusivement depuis un lieu de travail déclaré situé sur le territoire français. Le télétravail depuis l’étranger n’est pas autorisé Planning organisé par rotation et communiqué à l’avance ; Déplacements ponctuels possibles au siège ou sur certaines opérations, notamment pendant la période de formation ; Formation technique assurée en interne ; Participation à la création d’un nouveau pôle stratégique pour le développement international de Mac-Lloyd. Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

Nabla’s phenomenal traction is the result of 3 years of diligent product development.

Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale.

Your team

At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership.

As a Full-stack Engineer, you'll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product.

The technical challenges

  • Volumetry and efficiency: We handle more than 2.5 million medical encounters per month. Each one is automatically turned into a clinical note sent to the clinician's patient record system, saving thousands of hours of administrative work and giving healthcare professionals more time for their patients.

  • Real-time audio transcription: capturing and streaming audio reliably, from in-person visits as well as video consultations, and turning it into transcripts with very low latency

  • Resilience: keeping the product working on weak or unstable networks, with no data lost and no disruption to the clinician

  • Healthcare integrations: building robust connections to the third-party medical systems clinicians already rely on.

  • Complex AI services: designing and running multi-stage LLM pipelines and agentic workflows at scale, with the reliability and auditability a clinical setting requires

These challenges come with demanding product requirements:

  • Zero friction: clinicians have no time to learn a new tool, so the product must be fast to set up, intuitive, and useful from the very first consultation

  • Trust: what we generate goes into patient records, so quality and reliability are non-negotiable

  • Works everywhere: web, desktop and mobile, in clinics, hospitals or remote consultations

  • Build and improve product features across web, desktop and mobile platforms

  • Design and evolve the back-end APIs and services that power them

  • Collaborate closely with Product, ML, and Design to take projects from idea to production

  • Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to team best practices

  • Learn from senior engineers and grow your skills across the stack

  • Curious, eager to learn, and motivated to grow in a fast-moving team

  • Care about code quality and maintainability

  • Enjoy working in an international team where English is our primary language

Our Stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, Rust, Electron

  • Backend: Kotlin / JVM, GraphQL, PostgreSQL

  • ML & Infra: Python, PyTorch, Slurm, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes

Where you'll be based

Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers)

Remote policy: 2 days a week

At Pennylane, our website is a key engine for acquisition and conversion, transforming traffic from SEO, paid acquisition, media, and partnerships into demo bookings and self-sign-ups.

 

With over 450,000 monthly visits, our website already brings together conversion, product management, engineering, and tracking. We are seeking a Head of Website & Conversion to provide clear leadership, structure the team, and scale our conversion performance.

 

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will lead a multidisciplinary squad and ensure the website’s speed, quality, and business impact.

 
 

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising clients.

 

A few figures illustrating our scale and ambition:

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 
 

What You’ll Do

You will lead our Website squad and collaborate closely with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Demand Gen, Data, Brand, and Automation teams.

 

Lead and Grow the Website Squad

  • Set clear roles, objectives, and rituals

  • Manage and develop multidisciplinary profiles across conversion, product, and engineering

  • Foster growth in autonomy and seniority

  • Integrate AI into daily work to accelerate processes (e.g., backlog management, landing-page creation)

  • Recruit additional talent as needed

 

Drive Conversion

  • Define and prioritize initiatives that improve demo bookings and self-sign-ups

  • Frame, challenge, and unblock projects while empowering owners

  • Monitor conversion KPIs and ensure focus on measurable business impact

  • Share results and learnings with Growth, Sales, and Product teams

 

Scale Experimentation

  • Enhance the pace and quality of our A/B testing program

  • Structure identification, prioritization, design, and analysis of hypotheses

  • Ensure statistical rigor and clear decision-making from experiments

  • Make experimentation a consistent driver of website performance

 

Deliver Strategic Projects

  • Lead brand redesigns and update commercial messaging

  • Support new product launches with self-sign-up journeys

  • Prepare the website for international expansion

  • Coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and handle competing priorities

 

Protect Technical and Data Foundations

  • Partner with Engineering to ensure website performance, reliability, and security

  • Own tracking plan and conversion data quality

  • Align Growth and Data teams on trusted metrics and reporting

 
 

What You Bring

  • 7–10 years of experience in Growth, Conversion, or Product, including people-management

  • Strong expertise in CRO and/or product management for a high-traffic website

  • Proven track record in delivering measurable conversion improvements

  • Experience managing and developing multidisciplinary teams

  • Deep understanding of experimentation and A/B testing methodologies

  • Ability to collaborate with Engineering on performance, tracking, and security (coding not required)

  • Experience leading complex projects with multiple business and technical stakeholders

  • Strong leadership, communication, and prioritization skills

  • Hands-on experience using AI to enhance personal and team operations

  • Fluent English

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, marketplaces, self-sign-up models, or fast-growing e-commerce (plus), along with tracking and analytics knowledge

 
 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with experimentation, tracking, and analytics tools such as AB Tasty, GA4, GTM, and Amplitude and use AI to boost squad operations and execution.

 
 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of a strategic website attracting over 450,000 visits per month

  • Direct and measurable impact on demo bookings, self-sign-ups, and company growth

  • Opportunity to structure and grow a multidisciplinary Website squad

  • Key role in scaling Pennylane’s culture of experimentation

  • High-visibility projects across brand, product, and international expansion

  • Close collaboration with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Data, and Brand teams

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, and learning

 
 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 
 

🔎 Recruitment Process

  1. Talent Acquisition interview (30 min, remote)

  2. Interview with the Head of Growth (45 min, remote)

  3. Case study and presentation (1 hour, preferably in person)

  4. Interview with future direct reports (45 min, remote or in person)

  5. Final interview with our CMO (30 min)

 
 

🌈 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

 

If you’re excited about this role and think you could make an impact, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement.

raw.title: Head of Website & Conversion
raw.description:
Why this role exists ?

At Pennylane, our website is a key engine for acquisition and conversion, transforming traffic from SEO, paid acquisition, media, and partnerships into demo bookings and self-sign-ups.

 

With over 450,000 monthly visits, our website already brings together conversion, product management, engineering, and tracking. We are seeking a Head of Website & Conversion to provide clear leadership, structure the team, and scale our conversion performance.

 

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will lead a multidisciplinary squad and ensure the website’s speed, quality, and business impact.

 
 

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising clients.

 

A few figures illustrating our scale and ambition:

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 
 

What You’ll Do

You will lead our Website squad and collaborate closely with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Demand Gen, Data, Brand, and Automation teams.

 

Lead and Grow the Website Squad

  • Set clear roles, objectives, and rituals

  • Manage and develop multidisciplinary profiles across conversion, product, and engineering

  • Foster growth in autonomy and seniority

  • Integrate AI into daily work to accelerate processes (e.g., backlog management, landing-page creation)

  • Recruit additional talent as needed

 

Drive Conversion

  • Define and prioritize initiatives that improve demo bookings and self-sign-ups

  • Frame, challenge, and unblock projects while empowering owners

  • Monitor conversion KPIs and ensure focus on measurable business impact

  • Share results and learnings with Growth, Sales, and Product teams

 

Scale Experimentation

  • Enhance the pace and quality of our A/B testing program

  • Structure identification, prioritization, design, and analysis of hypotheses

  • Ensure statistical rigor and clear decision-making from experiments

  • Make experimentation a consistent driver of website performance

 

Deliver Strategic Projects

  • Lead brand redesigns and update commercial messaging

  • Support new product launches with self-sign-up journeys

  • Prepare the website for international expansion

  • Coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and handle competing priorities

 

Protect Technical and Data Foundations

  • Partner with Engineering to ensure website performance, reliability, and security

  • Own tracking plan and conversion data quality

  • Align Growth and Data teams on trusted metrics and reporting

 
 

What You Bring

  • 7–10 years of experience in Growth, Conversion, or Product, including people-management

  • Strong expertise in CRO and/or product management for a high-traffic website

  • Proven track record in delivering measurable conversion improvements

  • Experience managing and developing multidisciplinary teams

  • Deep understanding of experimentation and A/B testing methodologies

  • Ability to collaborate with Engineering on performance, tracking, and security (coding not required)

  • Experience leading complex projects with multiple business and technical stakeholders

  • Strong leadership, communication, and prioritization skills

  • Hands-on experience using AI to enhance personal and team operations

  • Fluent English

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, marketplaces, self-sign-up models, or fast-growing e-commerce (plus), along with tracking and analytics knowledge

 
 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with experimentation, tracking, and analytics tools such as AB Tasty, GA4, GTM, and Amplitude and use AI to boost squad operations and execution.

 
 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of a strategic website attracting over 450,000 visits per month

  • Direct and measurable impact on demo bookings, self-sign-ups, and company growth

  • Opportunity to structure and grow a multidisciplinary Website squad

  • Key role in scaling Pennylane’s culture of experimentation

  • High-visibility projects across brand, product, and international expansion

  • Close collaboration with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Data, and Brand teams

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, and learning

 
 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 
 

🔎 Recruitment Process

  1. Talent Acquisition interview (30 min, remote)

  2. Interview with the Head of Growth (45 min, remote)

  3. Case study and presentation (1 hour, preferably in person)

  4. Interview with future direct reports (45 min, remote or in person)

  5. Final interview with our CMO (30 min)

 
 

🌈 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

 

If you’re excited about this role and think you could make an impact, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 
 

⚠️ Important Information for Candidates

Apply only through Pennylane’s official channels. Our communications come from addresses ending in ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"> 

We will never ask for payments or financial information during the recruitment process.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement. Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives. 2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration. Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires. Indicateurs de réussite CSAT sur ton portefeuille. Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL. Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux. Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention. Profil recherché Expérience de 5 ans minimum : en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale) Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur. You'll join our Growth Engineering team and work closely with Thomas, our Growth Engineering Team Lead , within the Marketing Website squad. Your mission ? Make sure we collect the right data, trust what we measure and turn insights into better growth decisions. Someone who enjoys solving technical problems, working with different teams and making sure that business decisions are based on data people can trust. You don't need to be a data scientist or a marketing specialist. But you should be comfortable working at the intersection of software engineering, analytics and growth. We'd love to meet you if... You have a software engineering experience, with hands-on exposure to tracking, analytics or data integrations. You have implemented and maintained event tracking across websites, applications or acquisition funnels. You're fluent in AI-assisted development : you work with coding agents, create custom skills and instructions, use worktrees to parallelize work and keep code quality high. You're familiar with tools such as Segment, Amplitude, Google Tag Manager or similar platforms. You understand event schemas, data layers, user identification and tracking consistency. You're comfortable working with JavaScript and APIs to implement and troubleshoot tracking. You care about code quality, reliability and maintainability. You enjoy taking ownership of technical projects, from design to production. You're comfortable working in French and English. Technical ownership: You'll contribute to the architecture and reliability of our tracking ecosystem. Engineering standards: You'll work on technical challenges that require the same level of rigor as our other engineering teams. Cross-functional exposure: You'll collaborate with Growth, Marketing, Engineering and Data. International scale: You'll help build the data foundations needed to support our expansion across Europe. Continuous improvement: You'll have room to challenge existing implementations, propose better solutions and improve how we measure growth.
