raw.title: Growth Engineer - Data & Tracking
raw.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Your impact

Great growth decisions start with reliable data.

At Pennylane, we're building the financial operating system for European businesses. As we grow and expand into new markets, understanding how users discover, interact with and adopt our product is becoming increasingly important.

That's where Growth Engineering comes in.

We're looking for a Growth Engineer with strong data and tracking expertise to help us build reliable, scalable tracking and analytics foundations across our digital acquisition journeys.

You'll join our Growth Engineering team and work closely with Thomas, our Growth Engineering Team Lead, within the Marketing Website squad.

Your mission ? Make sure we collect the right data, trust what we measure and turn insights into better growth decisions.

What you'll do

Build reliable tracking foundations

You'll own the technical implementation and reliability of tracking across our website and acquisition funnels.

  • Design, implement and maintain tracking plans across key user journeys.

  • Build and improve event tracking, user identification and data collection.

  • Work with tools such as Segment, Amplitude and Google Tag Manager.

  • Ensure tracking consistency, accuracy and reliability across our digital ecosystem.

  • Identify and resolve tracking issues before they impact business decisions.

Connect data across our growth ecosystem

You'll help build the technical connections between our website, internal systems and analytics tools.

  • Develop and maintain APIs and integrations between platforms.

  • Ensure reliable data flows between our acquisition, product and analytics tools.

  • Collaborate with Data teams to improve data quality and consistency.

  • Support the evolution of our tracking architecture as Pennylane scales internationally.

Power experimentation and conversion

You'll work closely with Growth, Marketing and Data teams to understand user behavior and improve acquisition performance.

  • Implement the technical foundations for A/B testing and experimentation.

  • Help measure acquisition funnels and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Ensure experiments are properly tracked and measurable.

  • Translate business questions into clear technical tracking requirements.

  • Support data-driven decisions through reliable instrumentation.

Contribute as an engineer

This is an engineering role, not a reporting or dashboarding position.

You'll be expected to bring strong technical fundamentals and take ownership of your work.

  • Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

  • Build scalable and reliable technical solutions.

  • Investigate complex tracking and data issues.

  • Improve existing systems, processes and documentation.

  • Collaborate with engineers across Growth, Engineering and Data teams.

  • Contribute to technical decisions and engineering best practices.

Who are you?

We're looking for an engineer who understands both how data is collected and why it matters.

Someone who enjoys solving technical problems, working with different teams and making sure that business decisions are based on data people can trust.

You don't need to be a data scientist or a marketing specialist. But you should be comfortable working at the intersection of software engineering, analytics and growth.

We'd love to meet you if...

  • You have a software engineering experience, with hands-on exposure to tracking, analytics or data integrations.

  • You have implemented and maintained event tracking across websites, applications or acquisition funnels.

  • You're fluent in AI-assisted development : you work with coding agents, create custom skills and instructions, use worktrees to parallelize work and keep code quality high.

  • You're familiar with tools such as Segment, Amplitude, Google Tag Manager or similar platforms.

  • You understand event schemas, data layers, user identification and tracking consistency.

  • You're comfortable working with JavaScript and APIs to implement and troubleshoot tracking.

  • You care about code quality, reliability and maintainability.

  • You enjoy taking ownership of technical projects, from design to production.

  • You're comfortable working in French and English.

Bonus points if you have experience with:

  • Ruby on Rails, Vue.js or Nuxt.js.

  • SQL and data warehouses.

  • Server-side tracking and conversion APIs.

  • A/B testing and experimentation platforms.

  • Attribution, conversion measurement or acquisition analytics.

  • Privacy-conscious tracking and consent management.

  • International websites and multi-market acquisition funnels.

Our technical environment

Our Growth Engineering team works with:

  • Frontend: JavaScript, Vue.js, Nuxt.js

  • Backend: Ruby on Rails

  • Database: PostgreSQL

  • Development: Git, GitHub

  • Analytics & Tracking: Segment, Amplitude and other analytics tools, depending on the project

You'll collaborate closely with our Data teams and contribute to the evolution of our growth tracking infrastructure.

Why you'll love this role

  • Real impact: Your work will help teams understand how users discover and adopt Pennylane.

  • Technical ownership: You'll contribute to the architecture and reliability of our tracking ecosystem.

  • Engineering standards: You'll work on technical challenges that require the same level of rigor as our other engineering teams.

  • Cross-functional exposure: You'll collaborate with Growth, Marketing, Engineering and Data.

  • International scale: You'll help build the data foundations needed to support our expansion across Europe.

  • Continuous improvement: You'll have room to challenge existing implementations, propose better solutions and improve how we measure growth.

If you enjoy building reliable data foundations and want to see your engineering work directly influence growth decisions, we'd love to meet you.

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

  • To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

  • To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

  • To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden möchten wir wachsen und neue digitale Wege beschreiten. StackWorks macht als zertifizierter Partner von Google und Microsoft die IT von Schweizer KMU einfacher, sicherer und automatisierter. Ihre Rolle Sie bauen die StackWorks-Kompetenz in Automation, AI und Agentics auf und entwickeln sie weiter. Sie entwickeln, integrieren und betreiben AI Agents, die Geschäftsprozesse automatisieren, plattformübergreifend auf Google Gemini Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot Studio und Microsoft Foundry sowie vergleichbaren Agent-Plattformen. Sie sind technische Sparringinstanz für unsere Cloud Consultants in Pre-Sales und Projekten. Ihre Aufgaben Konzipieren, Entwickeln und Testen von AI Agents für interne und kundenseitige Use Cases in Collaboration, Operations, Sales und Finance Anbinden von Agents an Quell- und Zielsysteme über APIs und MCP-Schnittstellen (Create, Read, Update, Delete) Ableiten konkreter Use Cases aus Geschäftsprozessen und Übersetzen in Agent-Architekturen Auswahl, Bewertung und produktiver Einsatz der relevanten Agent-Plattformen (Google Gemini Enterprise und Vertex AI Agents, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry und weitere) Aufsetzen von Guard Rails, Monitoring, Logging und Cost Controls für produktive Agents Erstellen technischer Dokumentation, Architekturskizzen und reproduzierbarer Patterns als interne Agent Building Blocks Technische Unterstützung der Cloud Consultants in Pre-Sales und Delivery (Machbarkeitsabklärungen, Demos, Prototypen) Aufbau und Pflege eines internen Agent-Portfolios als Referenz- und Lernumgebung Beobachten der Marktentwicklung im Bereich Agentics und Einbringen relevanter Innovationen Ihr Profil Laufendes oder abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar (BSc oder MSc) Solide Programmierkenntnisse, idealerweise Python und/oder JavaScript bzw. TypeScript Verständnis für moderne AI-Konzepte: LLMs, Prompting, Tool Use, MCP, Agent-Architekturen Affinität zu Cloud-Plattformen und APIs (Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) Strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Problemlösekompetenz Selbständigkeit und Lernbereitschaft in einem dynamischen Technologiefeld Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Consultants und Kunden, klare schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation (Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch sehr gut) Erste praktische Erfahrungen mit Agent-Plattformen (Google Gemini Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, LangChain o. ä.) sind ein Plus Sie streben die Google Cloud Digital Leader Zertifizierung sowie relevante Professional-Zertifizierungen an Ihre Schnittstellen Cloud Consultants und Cloud Engineers: Use-Case-Diskussion, technische Umsetzung, Pre-Sales-Support Head of Cloud Engineering (CTO): Architektur, Standards, Technology Choice Managing Director: Strategie und Portfolio-Entwicklung im Bereich Automation und AI Ihre Entwicklung Der Weg ist klar vorgezeichnet: vom Trainee über Junior AI Engineer und AI Engineer bis zum Senior AI Engineer. Benefits Hybrid Work: Die Hälfte Ihrer Arbeitszeit im Homeoffice, die andere Hälfte mit dem Team im Büro in St. Gallen. Work hard, play hard: Gemeinsam gehen wir ins Workout, um den Kopf zu befreien und den Körper in Schwung zu bringen. Wir beteiligen uns an Ihrem Fitness-Abo. Learn & Grow: Ein Kontingent für Workshops, Schulungen, Zertifizierungen und externe Kurse. A heart for birthday: Lassen Sie sich feiern! Dieser eine, besondere Tag im Jahr gehört nur Ihnen und Sie haben frei. Cold Refresh: Unser Kühlschrank ist immer gefüllt mit Getränken, dazu frischer Kaffee aus der Rocket-Maschine. Experience true adventures: Regelmässige Events und Teamlunches schweissen uns zusammen und erweitern unseren Horizont. So geht es weiter Senden Sie uns Ihre Unterlagen direkt hier über JOIN. Ishan Don meldet sich persönlich bei Ihnen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Product Marketing Manager
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role Agentic process automation is a category enterprises are actively budgeting for - and one crowded with claims. As our Product Marketing Manager, you make sure blp's story cuts through; sharp positioning against the alternatives our buyers actually consider, messaging that speaks to CFOs and COOs in business outcomes rather than technology, and sales teams equipped to win against ERP workflow add-ons, RPA vendors, and point-AI copilots. This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the center of how blp goes to market. You will own the translation layer between product capability and buyer value - across launches, enablement, competitive intelligence, and the content that carries our positioning into every deal. What you'll do Own positioning and messaging execution . Maintain and evolve blp's messaging house: value proposition, pillars, proof points, and persona-specific narratives, and enforce its consistent use across web, decks, campaigns, and sales conversations. Build and maintain competitive intelligence . Own battlecards and competitive positioning against ERP workflow automation, RPA, IDP/point-AI solutions, and adjacent AI platforms; keep sales ahead of competitor moves and objection patterns. Enable the field. Create and maintain the core sales toolkit - first-meeting decks, discovery guides, objection handling, ROI narratives, and persona playbooks for CFO, COO, shared services, and process excellence audiences. Sharpen personas and ICP. Continuously refine our understanding of buying committees, triggers (ERP transformation, e-invoicing mandates, shared-services efficiency programs), and where we win and lose - grounded in win/loss analysis and field feedback. Drive product launches and releases . Turn platform capabilities and new workflow coverage into launch narratives, internal enablement, and external announcements that land with executive buyers. Fuel demand and thought leadership . Supply campaigns, events, and content marketing with differentiated angles, from executive-facing reports to industry-specific value narratives. Be the voice of the market internally. Bring buyer, analyst, and competitive insight back into product and leadership discussions, even when it complicates the roadmap story, to sharpen framing and packaging. What you'll bring 5–8 years in B2B software marketing, with at least 3 years in product marketing for enterprise SaaS - ideally in ERP-adjacent, finance operations, automation, or applied-AI categories. Proven ability to market to economic buyers: you write for CFOs, CIOs/CTOs, and COOs in the language of cost, productivity, working capital, and EBIT - not features. Strong competitive instincts: experience building battlecards and positioning in crowded categories, and translating technical differentiation into commercial arguments. A portfolio of enablement assets that sales teams actually used - you measure your work by win rates and message adoption, not asset counts. Analytical rigor: comfortable with win/loss analysis, market and analyst research, and grounding messaging claims in defensible evidence. Excellent writing and presentation craft in English; German is a strong plus for our DACH-concentrated customer base. Enough technical depth to understand ERP processes, AI agents, and enterprise integration well enough to challenge product - and simplify it for buyers. What you'll get Category-defining work. Agentic process automation is being defined now, and you will shape how the market understands it. Real substance. 550+ enterprise customers and measurable outcomes mean your positioning rests on proof, not promises. Scope and access. You get a seat at the table with product, sales leadership, and the executive team, and your work goes straight into deals and board narratives. A company at an inflection point. It has a strong European base, fresh US market entry, and a proven platform to build the story on. Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers . title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. Help us take Wingtra’s new product platforms from fast prototypes to reliable series production. Embedded in the engineering team, you own mechanical design, qualification and industrialization through initial ramp-up. Together we deliver a qualified product, a complete product file and a working production line. We are early adopters of AI and actively build agentic workflows across engineering, from design and test planning to execution and analysis. Responsibilities Take a new aircraft from concept to series production. You work in a small team with electronics designers and test engineers. You get direct feedback from prototypes, flight tests and production builds. Design and iterate lightweight parts. You design, build and test parts and assemblies, then improve them until they are ready for production. Choose materials and processes with care. You balance performance, volumes, unit cost, tooling investment and lead times. Own DFX. You design for manufacturing, assembly, quality, cost and serviceability, and you settle tolerances, interfaces and process constraints early. Work hand in hand with suppliers. You partner with sourcing on technical feasibility, tooling and part iterations. Own qualification. You qualify parts with the intended production materials and processes, and you agree product-specific acceptance criteria with the test engineers. Deliver the production-ready product file. CAD, 2D drawings, tolerances, BOMs, material and process specifications and acceptance criteria. Hand over a running line. Once the qualification gates have passed and ramp-up is complete, you hand the line and the product file to Production and Production Engineering. Requirements You have several years of experience taking mechanical products through the full lifecycle: prototype, series production and quality monitoring at the customer. Ideally on structurally critical products at volumes of hundreds to a few thousand units. You are strong in CAD (Solidworks/PDM preferred), tolerance analysis and material selection. You have practical experience with injection molding as well as additive manufacturing for functional plastic parts. You prototype fast and pragmatically, then qualify and document with discipline. You like hands-on work: builds, testing and working with suppliers. You use AI for design exploration, qualification planning and data analysis. You check its output, share new workflows and keep raising the team’s bar. You are curious, flexible and collaborative, with a real drive to build the next great thing. If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you. title: Principal Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What Is The Role:</strong></h3> <p>We are on the lookout for a <strong>Principal Software Engineer</strong><span style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px;"><strong> </strong></span>to join our <strong>Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team </strong>and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What You Will Be Doing:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leveraging your deep distributed systems expertise to design, build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.</li> <li>Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.</li> <li>Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.</li> <li>Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.</li> <li>Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.</li> <li>Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.</li> <li>Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You Bring:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.</li> <li>You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.</li> <li>You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.</li> <li>You have experience building large-scale distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.&nbsp;</li> <li>You have experience building and debugging complex features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.</li> <li>You are able to own projects from beginning to end. title: Head of Insurance Supply
description: 🍇 About grape:    Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first.   At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you! Your role As Head of Insurance Supply, you will own grape’s carrier and reinsurance partnerships. You will build and diversify our capacity panel, secure the structures behind existing and new products, and ensure our insurance supply grows with the business. Today, this responsibility is led by our CEOs. You will take it over, build it into a dedicated function and represent Insurance Supply as a member of grape’s Leadership Team. What you’ll do: 1. Build and diversify our capacity panel Develop grape’s capacity strategy for Switzerland and Liechtenstein. Identify, qualify, negotiate with and onboard new carriers and reinsurers. Lead relationships from the first conversation through due diligence, commercial negotiation and signed agreement. Secure the contracted capacity required for grape’s annual business plan and written commitments for the following year. Diversify the panel to support growth, enable new products and reduce concentration risk.   2. Build strong carrier partnerships Own carrier and reinsurer relationships at operational, commercial and executive level. Establish a clear governance cadence, including operational reviews, strategic meetings and annual capacity negotiations. Own commercial terms, contracts, renewals, outsourcing agreements and service levels. Monitor partnership performance, resolve issues early and build relationships that grow over time. Represent grape credibly across the insurance, reinsurance and broking market.   3. Shape products and build the function Design and secure the carrier and reinsurance structures required for new products. Evaluate pricing, loss ratios, reserving, commissions, capital requirements and solvency implications. Work closely with Actuarial, Underwriting, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Product and Distribution. Own the Insurance Supply strategy, priorities, OKRs, processes and reporting. Provide the Leadership Team with a clear view of capacity coverage, pipeline and risk. Hire and lead a Carrier Partnerships Manager as the function grows. What you’ll bring: At least eight years of insurance experience, including carrier partnerships, MGA capacity management, programme business, reinsurance broking or business development at a carrier. A demonstrated track record of taking capacity relationships from initial contact through negotiation to a signed binding authority, treaty or comparable agreement. Strong commercial judgement and the confidence to negotiate with senior stakeholders across carriers, reinsurers, MGAs and brokers. A strong understanding of insurance portfolio economics, including loss ratios, reserving, pricing, capacity and capital implications. Experience building long-term external partnerships and a relevant network across the carrier, reinsurance or broking market. The ability to move between strategy, relationship building, negotiation and operational detail. Fluent English. Strong advantage: Experience working within an MGA or directly with MGA and programme structures. Knowledge of Swiss and Liechtenstein employee insurance, particularly KTG, UVG and UVG-Z. Familiarity with the Swiss and Liechtenstein regulatory environment. German or French proficiency. Experience building or leading a capacity or carrier-partnerships function. If you have built insurance capacity partnerships in another European market and can transfer that experience to Switzerland and Liechtenstein, we would still like to hear from you. 🤝 What we offer in return: 🌱 Empowering workplace: Join a passionate team and an empowering workplace where you are given the ownership, tools, and support to make decisions and take initiative. Together we grow and build innovative solutions. 💻  Hybrid setup: Enjoy the flexibility of our hybrid work schedule, with the freedom to work remotely or from our office in Zurich. On Thursdays, our team day, we meet together in our Zurich office. 🪑 Home office stipend: To enable our hybrid setup, we allocate a one-off CHF 200.- home office budget to help you set up your dream workspace in the comfort of your own home. 🌐  Internet allowance: We give you a monthly internet allowance to help cover your internet costs at home and enable you to work seamlessly from your home office. ⏳ Flexible working time: You can distribute your working hours the way you want to. 🧠  Learning budget: We support you in improving your skills, acquiring new knowledge and advancing your career. We also allocate a CHF 1'500.- budget annually ❤️‍🩹  Well-being: Work-life balance is important to us and we foster a supportive work environment. We support you with mental health sessions with our partner Aepsy. 🎫  Team events: Every month we gather for fun and engaging events where we can connect and bond with our colleagues and our teams. ✈️   Team retreats: Once a year we travel somewhere nice to bond with our colleagues. 🚂   Travel and commute: We will cover your SBB half fare card, so we can spend some time together in the office. 🌴 Paid vacation: You get 5 weeks (25 days) of paid vacation every year and 2 additional days of paid vacation to compensate for canton-related holidays, religious holidays, birthdays, etc. The total amount of paid vacation days per year is 27 days. 🧖‍♀️  Wellness budget: Health and well-being looks different for everyone. You can optimize your wellness budget to best fit your needs. 👨‍👨‍👦‍👦 Parental and adoptive leave: We offer additional time off to support employees who are balancing family and work time in the most crucial stages of family life. ✈️  Digital nomad: For every 3 years of employment, you can work for an extended period of time from anywhere in the world (location subject to review).   🏁 Our recruitment process We place particular emphasis on four areas when making our selection decision: professional and technical skills, mindset & values. We evaluate these through the following steps:   Step 1 - Your motivation To get to know you better, we invite you to a 30-minute motivational interview with our Talent Acquisition Team. Step 2 - Role fit In the first interview, we assess how well your qualifications and skills align with the role requirements. This discussion will take place with your Hiring Manager. Step 3 - Case study For roles with higher technical demands, we will invite you to complete a case study or technical assessment. This allows us to better evaluate your specific skills and problem-solving abilities. Step 4 - Our culture connect Throughout the interview process, you'll gain insight into our company culture, and we'll explore how your values and mindset align with our ways of working. The final interview will offer a deeper look into this connection, along with broader discussions about the role and our vision.   Our diverse experiences, perspectives, and voices make us the company we are, and we would love to learn more about you! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- Health is our foundation. Innovation drives our mission. Together, we’re building the future of employee insurance. At grape, collaboration isn’t just a buzzword, it’s the foundation of how we work, live, and succeed. From bold brainstorms and lessons learned, we overcome challenges side by side. Our time together is our greatest asset. Disrupting an industry that truly needs change takes courage, creativity, and team spirit and that’s exactly what defines us. With well-being at the core, we foster an environment where ideas and people thrive. Your growth matters as much as our mission. Whether it’s supporting your self-care, developing new solutions, or redefining how health and insurance connect, we grow together. Our values guide us every step of the way: keeping  Health at Heart ,  Invent ing  Together , and always striving to  Embrace Clarity . Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Du priorisierst, wo wir zuerst gewinnen. Leads in Kund:innen verwandeln. Qualifizierungsgespräche, Webinare, Demos, Follow-up während der Testphase, Abschluss. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Schweizer Kund:innen. Neue Kanäle erschliessen. Berufsverbände wie FSP, ASP und SBAP, Weiterbildungsinstitute, Fachveranstaltungen und Kongresse. Erstansprache per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn, wo sie sich lohnt. Playbook bauen, während du verkaufst. Du passt an, was zum Verkaufen und Vermarkten in der Schweiz am besten wirkt, von Sprache bis Preisdarstellung in CHF. Feedback ins Produkt bringen. Was Schweizer Kund:innen brauchen und woran Deals scheitern, besprichst du direkt mit dem Produktteam. Dein Profil Must-have Nachgewiesene Abschlüsse im B2B-Vertrieb in der Schweiz, idealerweise SaaS oder Digital Health, belegbar in Zahlen Echte Hunter-Mentalität. Du hast bereits aktiv Erstkontakte am Telefon gemacht und hast damit kein Problem. Wenn dich 40 Gespräche am Tag abschrecken, ist das die falsche Rolle Kenntnis des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens oder die Fähigkeit, dich sehr schnell einzuarbeiten: Grundversicherung, Anordnungsmodell, Rolle von Kantonen und Verbänden Glaubwürdigkeit gegenüber Therapeut:innen. Psychotherapeut:innen vertrauen vor allem Psychotherapeut:innen. Unsere Zielgruppe ist häufig erst nach der letzten Sitzung erreichbar, Termine zwischen 17 und 19 Uhr gehören dazu. DACH-Marktführer für KI-Assistenz in der Psychotherapie in zwei Jahren, bootstrapped. Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixum in CHF plus ungedeckelte Provision, dazu Beteiligung am Unternehmen Direkter Draht. Jede Praxis, die du gewinnst, bedeutet mehrere Stunden pro Woche, die wieder Patient:innen zugutekommen Flexibel arbeiten. Remote aus der Schweiz, freie Zeiteinteilung, moderne Ausstattung und regelmässige Teamtage in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte Wir suchen keine:n klassische:n Vertriebler:in, sondern eine:n Macher:in, die oder der mit Hunger und Hands-on-Mentalität VIA in der Schweiz zur ersten Wahl macht. At Scalera, that part is done: manufacturers, suppliers and contractors across Switzerland, Austria and Germany already run their tenders through us every day.

What we need now are people who can take the next unsolved problem and turn it into a product customers can't do without. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first engineer somewhere, or built something people paid for, this role was written for you.

About Scalera

Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Large manufacturers and suppliers still run their most document-heavy processes by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate them one by one. Our product matching already handles 1,400 tender positions in 16 minutes at 98% precision, work that used to take a sales rep most of a day.

What you'll do

You'll be part product manager, part engineer. You'll spend real time with customers and help shape what we build. Sometimes you'll spot the next problem yourself, and sometimes we'll hand you a clear priority to run with.

  • Spend real time with customers. Join calls and site visits, sit with the people who do the work, and understand why they do it the way they do. You'll know their problems firsthand, not from a ticket.

  • Shape what to build. Turn what you hear into a clear problem, a scope and a plan, and push back when the obvious request isn't the real need. When we bring you a priority, you'll own how it gets solved.

  • Build it. Design and build backend services in Go and Python that turn messy tenders, catalogs and purchase orders into data customers can rely on.

  • Ship, then check. Get it in front of customers fast, watch how they actually use it, and iterate.

  • Own it in production. When something breaks at a customer, it's yours to understand and fix.

  • Build with AI. Use AI heavily in how you work, and design systems that agents can use as well as people.

What success looks like after 3 months

  • There's a part of the product people now think of as yours, and you're the one deciding what happens to it next

  • You've spotted a problem nobody asked you to solve, made the case for it, and shipped a first version

  • You've shipped features from both sources: priorities we set and ideas from your own customer conversations

  • At least once, you've talked us out of building something customers didn't really need

  • You've left a part of the platform simpler than you found it

You'll probably thrive here if

  • You've taken something from zero to one: a company, a product line, or a side project with paying users

  • You've built and run backend systems in production that other people depend on. We care more about your judgment than your language; you're strong in Go or Python and happy to work in both

  • You're solid on data modeling, API design and messy real-world data

  • You'd rather talk to a customer than wait for a spec

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make progress while the problem is still half-defined, which at a startup it usually is

  • You want a large scope of responsibility and are happy to own things well beyond your job title

  • Rapidly changing requirements don't throw you. When customers or priorities shift, you adapt and keep going

  • You enjoy direct customer contact and want to be on customer calls

  • You make things simpler over time, not more clever

  • You write clearly in English. German is a plus, not a requirement

You probably won't enjoy it if

  • You just want to code and go home

  • You don't like talking to customers, whether on calls or on the occasional site visit

  • Ambiguity and chaos bother you

  • You want a well-defined backlog handed to you

  • Your main goal is managing people soon. Here, scope grows with what you own, not with headcount

Our stack

Go and Python (FastAPI), PostgreSQL, GCP, and LLMs throughout the document pipeline. You don't need to know all of it on day one.

How we hire

  1. Screening call (30 min) with our VP Engineering. It's two-way: ask us anything, including the hard questions.

  2. Technical deep-dive call: walk us through something you built from scratch, the decisions you made and what went wrong.

  3. Meet Scalera Day: join us remotely to work on a real problem with real (anonymized) construction documents, and meet the team.

  4. Offer: if it's a fit on both sides, we'll move quickly to an offer.

Working at Scalera

  • Remote within the EU or EEA

  • Small team, no bureaucracy. You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO, VP Engineering and Customer Success

  • Competitive compensation

Founders and former founders: if you're unsure whether you fit, send a few lines about what you built and why you moved on. We read every one.

  • Ambiguity and chaos bother you.

  • You want a well-defined research agenda handed to you.

Our stack

Python and PyTorch, open-weight and frontier LLMs, LangGraph, Langfuse, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Pinecone, and GCP. You don't need to know all of it on day one.

How we hire

  1. Screening call (30 min) with our VP Engineering. It's two-way: ask us anything, including the hard questions.

  4. Offer: if it's a fit on both sides, we'll move quickly to an offer.

Working at Scalera

  • Zürich HQ, four days in the office, Fridays remote. If not located in Zürich then this role is open to remote within the EU or EEA,

  • Occasional customer visits across Switzerland, Austria and Germany

  • Small team, no bureaucracy. You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO, VP Engineering and Customer Success

The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision. The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against. This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep. The mandate Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down. Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances. Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. That is disqualifying here. You lead from inside the work. You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them. You move people with the business case, not the whip. When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title. You have extreme ownership. You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach. You have genuine gravitas. Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom. raw.title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
raw.description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

By combining our Cloud Intelligence technology with Forward Deployed Engineers and deep specialization across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, we help tech-forward companies navigate their toughest infrastructure and cost governance challenges end to end.</p> <p><strong>The Opportunity</strong><br>As an Account Executive, Strategic Deals for <strong>Attribute™</strong>, you will be at the forefront of building a brand-new region from scratch and introducing a groundbreaking solution to a fundamental business problem in modern FinOps. You will work on Strategic Deals, leveraging strategic partnerships with AWS, OpenAI, Top Private Equity firms, and our global current install base. A strong focus will be placed on co-selling and unlocking strategic deal opportunities with AWS, ISVs, and channel partners. Traditional cloud cost allocation methods rely heavily on static tagging—an approach that becomes obsolete in modern, shared cloud and AI infrastructure. When multi-tenant clusters, shared GPUs, microservices, and dynamic AI workloads dominate, organizations face severe blind spots: they cannot accurately determine the true cost-to-serve for specific applications, autonomous agents, or business teams, making it impossible to calculate true gross margins at a granular customer level.</p> <p>Attribute™ solves this by taking a completely different approach. Leveraging runtime eBPF technology, Attribute™ captures real-time network traffic signals and kernel-level observability without requiring engineering teams to manually tag or instrument code. By analyzing actual runtime consumption across CPU, GPU, memory, network, and AI model API requests, it provides accurate total cost of ownership (TCO) and unit economics based on real usage. Organizations finally get precise cost governance and gross margin visibility across complex cloud and AI environments with zero developer overhead.</p> <p>As an Account Executive building this region from scratch, you will establish a high-potential greenfield territory. But the product you'll carry every day is Attribute™, and the market is only just learning it exists. <li>Build deep, mutually valuable relationships with AWS Sales Leaders and Partner Managers to co-sell and expand market share</li> <li>Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and Solutions Architects to solve the toughest technical challenges prospects face</li> <li>Maintain rigorous forecast accuracy in Salesforce and ensure every proposal reflects the quality of what we actually deliver</li> <li>Guide customers from initial curiosity through contract execution, setting them up for a world-class onboarding experience</li> <li>Feed real customer signal back to product and marketing every week — in a founding team, that loop is the job</li> <li>Generate your own pipeline through prospecting, networking, and creative outreach — not just working what's handed to you</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven track record of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience with a strong emphasis on net-new logo acquisition and building a regional territory from scratch</li> <li>A track record of selling cloud services and understanding how consumption-based models work</li> <li>Hunting mentality: demonstrated drive to self-generate pipeline, prospect into target accounts, and close new business independently</li> <li>Experience selling to platform engineering / DevOps teams.</li> <li>Comfort selling something new — you've sold a product before there was a Gartner quadrant for it, and you preferred it that way</li> <li>Technical curiosity: you understand the cloud computing market and can hold your own in conversations about AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure products and architecture</li> <li>Genuine interest in FinOps and how engineering organisations actually consume the cloud — you don't need to be a practitioner, but you need to care</li> business development activities</li> <li>Prior experience at AWS, ISVs, or in strategic partnerships is a big plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>Are You a Doer?</strong><br>Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.</p> <p>We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.</p> <p>What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun!<a href="https://careers.doit.com/life-at-doit/"> Click here to learn more about our Life at DoiT</a>.</p> <p>Sounds too good to be true? description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used. This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. What you'll ship Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle. Coordinate clear, well documented validation reports and model risk information that stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors and internal audit. What you'll bring Around 5 to 7 years of experience in model risk management or model validation within a bank, preferably across at least one of credit, IRRBB and capital models. Solid working knowledge of ECB model risk expectations and how model validation should be structured and evidenced. Comfort building a model risk framework and validation approach from the ground up. You're excited to write the first playbook. Strong quantitative skills to critically assess model methodology, assumptions and performance, and the discipline to document your findings so others, including a regulator, can follow them. The ability to explain model limitations and validation findings to model owners and senior stakeholders, and the confidence to hold your ground under challenge. Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of model validation that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgement and challenge. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. Your impact

Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used.

This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll design the policy, validation approach and governance from scratch, starting with the credit, IRRBB and capital models already in design for our future capital and liquidity planning. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day.

You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. Your challenge and sign off will be visible to senior leadership, audit and, eventually, our regulator. As Mollie grows and matures its model risk management, your scope grows from building the framework to running an ongoing model risk cycle.

What you'll ship

  • Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle.

  • Set up and maintain the model inventory for credit, IRRBB and capital models, with materiality and risk tiering for each.

  • Coordinate independent second line validation and challenge before models are used, including credit risk and ECL, IRRBB, and Pillar 1 and Pillar 2 capital models.

  • Design the ongoing monitoring and re-validation cycle with the Machine Learning team, covering performance testing, limitation tracking and re-validation triggers.

  • Partner with model owners in Credit Risk and Treasury ALM, and coordinate within the second line Risk function, so model risk challenge is built into the wider risk and capital frameworks.

  • Coordinate clear, well documented validation reports and model risk information that stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors and internal audit.

What you'll bring

  • Around 5 to 7 years of experience in model risk management or model validation within a bank, preferably across at least one of credit, IRRBB and capital models.

  • Solid working knowledge of ECB model risk expectations and how model validation should be structured and evidenced.

  • Comfort building a model risk framework and validation approach from the ground up. You're excited to write the first playbook.

  • Strong quantitative skills to critically assess model methodology, assumptions and performance, and the discipline to document your findings so others, including a regulator, can follow them.

  • The ability to explain model limitations and validation findings to model owners and senior stakeholders, and the confidence to hold your ground under challenge.

  • Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of model validation that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgement and challenge.

title: Customer Service Agent
description: Bij Crisp staan onze klanten op nummer één. Ons gezellige en hechte serviceteam doet er alles aan om die klanten van de beste service te voorzien. We hebben daarom veel persoonlijk contact met de klant, en ondersteunen onze bezorgers voor een vlekkeloze bezorging. We zijn nog volop in ontwikkeling, dus je denkt ook mee over hoe we onze service kunnen verbeteren. Wat je gaat doen Je hebt elke dag direct contact met onze klanten, vooral via Whatsapp. Zo maak je ze nog blijer nadat ze ons gesproken hebben. Daarnaast geef je feedback van klanten door aan de juiste teams binnen Crisp, zodat we onze service kunnen blijven verbeteren. Ook zorg je samen met onze bezorgers en je collega's op onze logistieke hubs dat bezorgingen vlekkeloos verlopen. Verder verdiep je je in onze processen. Zoals je al hoort, geen dag is hetzelfde! Hoe ziet een werkdag eruit? 's Ochtends hou je onze bezorgroutes goed in de gaten. Is het druk op de weg? Dan zorg jij ervoor dat onze klanten op tijd weten dat hun bezorger iets later is. Ondertussen pak je WhatsApp-berichtjes van klanten op. Je helpt ze met het aanpassen van hun bestelling, het kiezen van een bezorgtijd of beantwoordt vragen over ons assortiment. Zo leer je elke dag iets nieuws over eten! Lunchtijd! Elke dag lunchen we met onze eigen boodschappen. Een ideaal moment om ons assortiment én je collega's beter te leren kennen. Na de lunch beantwoord je vragen via WhatsApp, social media en e-mail, terwijl je collega's de bezorgingen in de gaten houden of bezig zijn met de processen. Je merkt dat er veel vragen zijn over een bepaalde marketingactie. Dat geef je dus meteen even door aan de juiste collega. De collega's die 's avonds werken nemen jouw taken over. Dat zorgt ervoor dat je de feedback die klanten doorgeven via de app nog even kunt verwerken. Tijd om af te sluiten. Samen met je collega's drink je nog een ijskoud Crisp-drankje in onze gezellige keuken. Dit ben jij Je herkent je in het volgende profiel: Je bent parttime (16-24 uur per week) beschikbaar. We zijn 7 dagen per week open van 07:30 tot 23:00 uur, en je werkt straks in shifts van 4 tot 8 uur. Daarom is flexibele beschikbaarheid voor overdag, avonden én in het weekend een must. Je woont in omgeving Amsterdam en bent voor minimaal één jaar beschikbaar. Een kantoor in de Amsterdamse Pijp met een grote keuken waar flink wordt geluncht, gezellig gekookt en waar de kans op zelfgebakken taart of vegan roze koeken groot is. Goed om te weten: vanaf januari 2027 groeien we door en verhuizen we naar een gloednieuwe, grotere locatie in de buurt van Zaandam, Sloterdijk en de Houthavens, waar we vanaf dan onze nieuwe thuisbasis hebben. Je schrijft en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands. Op een persoonlijke en creatieve manier reageren op klanten gaat jou makkelijk af. Je bent oplossingsgericht en empathisch. Je kunt je verplaatsen in onze klanten en begrijpt wat er nodig is om hun ervaring met Crisp nog beter te maken. Je bedenkt creatieve oplossingen om onze klanten te verrassen en verwachtingen te overtreffen. Als je klantenservice-ervaring hebt binnen organisaties waar kwaliteit hoog in het vaandel staat, is dat super! Wat wij bieden Een marktconform salaris, afhankelijk van leeftijd. Een gezellig en hecht team. Veel verantwoordelijkheid, uitdagend werk en een dynamische omgeving. Een kijkje in de keuken van een snelgroeiende start-up. We zijn volop in ontwikkeling dus jouw ideeën tellen mee. Werken bij een B-Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op ons voedselsysteem en échte verandering teweeg te brengen Enthousiaste en ondernemende collega’s om mee te werken en te leren. Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL. Voor nu een persoonlijk budget voor yoga, sport, mobiliteit en downtime via bijvoorbeeld ClassPass, Pathé en Blendle. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Tijd om je collega’s te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. Een kantoor in de Amsterdamse Pijp met een grote keuken waar flink wordt geluncht, gezellig gekookt en grote kans op zelfgebakken taart of vegan roze koeken. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Ben jij geïnteresseerd? Is de functie van Service Agent jou op het lijf geschreven, solliciteer dan via onderstaand button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. About the role

As SkyNRG grows, applications such as SAP Public Cloud, HubSpot, and our Inventory Management System are becoming increasingly important to our operations. We are looking for an Enterprise Applications Manager to take functional ownership of this landscape and ensure our systems effectively support the business.

You will connect business needs with IT solutions, translating requests into clear requirements and coordinated improvements. Working across Commercial, Operations, Maintenance, HSE, Finance and QA, you will create structure, improve adoption and act as the main point of contact for our enterprise applications.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Take functional ownership of SAP Public Cloud, including EAM and HSE, HubSpot, IMS, and other enterprise applications.

  • Translate business processes and needs into clear requirements, functional designs, user stories and test scenarios.

  • Manage functional support, incidents and change requests, coordinating with external partners and vendors where necessary.

  • Build and maintain the enterprise application roadmap, backlogs and change priorities with IT and business owners.

  • Configure applications within the functional scope and coordinate releases, testing and implementation.

  • Improve application adoption, data quality, reporting and integrations across the application landscape.

  • Maintain process documentation, user guides, application records and access roles in line with security and compliance requirements.

  • Train and support key users across the organization, helping teams make effective use of the available systems.

Your initial focus will include strengthening the use of SAP EAM and HSE, improving HubSpot’s commercial processes and reporting, and introducing a consistent intake and change process for business requests.

While this role does not have direct reports, you will coordinate external implementation partners and application vendors. You will also work closely with the wider IT team to ensure our enterprise applications are reliable, secure and aligned with business priorities.

Your profile

As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You feel comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, take ownership, and thrive when things are still developing.

You understand both business processes and enterprise technology. You can move comfortably between conversations with business stakeholders, technical colleagues, and external partners, translating different perspectives into practical solutions. Structured and pragmatic, you take end-to-end responsibility rather than simply passing requests along.

You recognize yourself in the following:

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • At least five years of experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, Application Owner, or in a comparable enterprise applications role.

  • Hands-on functional experience with SAP, ideally SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, in at least one relevant area such as EAM or Plant Maintenance, HSE or EHS, Finance, or Procurement.

  • Experience working with a CRM platform, preferably HubSpot.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate business processes and needs into clear requirements, functional designs, and test scenarios.

  • Experience managing application vendors or implementation partners, including support agreements and service levels.

  • Understanding of change management, release management, testing and access control in an enterprise environment.

  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to constructively challenge business requests.

  • Professional fluency in English.

Experience in an industrial, energy, chemical, manufacturing or asset-intensive environment would be an advantage. Familiarity with system integrations, SAP BTP, APIs, Power BI or data-quality initiatives would also be beneficial. Knowledge of relevant regulatory and compliance frameworks, such as NIS2, ISO 27001 and GDPR, is considered a plus.

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

  • 30 paid holidays + 2 for choosing sustainable travel options for your holidays

  • Attractive bonus scheme

  • €5.000,- dedicated budget every 3 years for professional development

  • Commuting travel reimbursement + Lease a Bike plan

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

About The Role

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Lifecycle to own measurement and experimentation for how new customers activate and existing ones stay.The metrics are yours whatever the lever: CRM campaigns, promos and incentives, onboarding changes in the product, and a next best action layer that decides what each customer should see next. You decide what we test, how we test it and what we do with the answer. You also bring your own hypotheses on where the next win is.

 


What You'll Do

What you'll do

Join activation and retention initiatives before anything is built, whether they come from CRM, growth or product. Define the primary metric, check against historical data whether the effect is detectable at our volumes, and turn solution-shaped requests into problem-shaped ones.

Design and analyse experiments end to end: hypothesis, guardrails, audience split, MDE and power, stopping rule, and a readout that ends in ship, iterate or kill. 

Correct for channel and engagement bias (not everyone opens email, and open and click populations are self-selected). When a clean A/B is impossible, use causal inference: diff-in-diff, matching, synthetic control or geo designs.

Bring hypotheses of your own. Launch a few new experiments across onboarding and the customer lifecycle, and turn one-off wins into recurring segmented flows.

Build deliberately simple models: segmentation, propensity, churn and dormancy scoring. They feed audiences, personalisation and incentive targeting. Over time these come together into next best action: for a given customer, which offer, feature nudge or message to send next, through which channel, and whether to send anything at all. You own the logic and the measurement of whether it beats the current rules.

Automate your own recurring work: audience refresh jobs, readout templates, dashboards for Activation, Onboarding and Retention. Ship models the Databricks way (scheduled jobs write tables, tables map into downstream tools such as Braze) and bring engagement data back into the warehouse to close the loop.

What you bring

  • Strong SQL and Python, and a Git-based warehouse workflow with code review.

  • Experiment design, statistics and metric design you can defend.

  • BI experience, Power BI/Tableau or similar.

  • Clustering and segmentation that ends up in use, not in a slide.

  • Predictive modelling with honest validation. Uplift modelling is a plus.

Tegelijkertijd groeit de behoefte aan praktische oplossingen, toepasbare kennis en slimme instrumenten die organisaties helpen om complexe digitale vraagstukken beheersbaar te maken.
